jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Technical Program Manager**

Stimulus Technologies – Broadband Division

**About Us**

Stimulus Technologies is a leader in technology services dedicated to bridging the digital divide in underserved communities. With operations across California, Missouri, Nevada, New Mexico, and Oregon, we deliver high-speed, reliable connectivity that transforms lives and businesses. We are a turnkey technology company providing Managed IT Services, VoIP, Cybersecurity, and high-speed Wireless Internet and fiber through Stimulus Broadband.

**Position Overview**

The Technical Program Manager runs the network and systems programs for Stimulus Broadband outside the fiber build: integration of existing markets onto standard platforms, integration of acquired companies, and wireless network projects. The role owns schedule, cost, scope, risk and project gates for this portfolio and coordinates with the fiber deployment organization where they two depend on each other. The Technical Program Manager reports to the CTO.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Own the portfolio and master schedule for network and systems integration programs.
* Market network integration program: migrate each market onto the target architecture and standard platforms, including cutover planning, subscriber migration and retiring legacy systems.
* Run acquisition integration from diligence through cutover and decommissioning.
* Manage wireless projects (sector augments, backhaul upgrades, site remediation) from scope through delivery, using contractors and field crews.
* Track the NMS/OSS deployment roadmap by market and keep platform, network and operations sequenced.
* Own program budgets and forecasts with finance.
* Run project gates and coordinate release to production with Network Operations.
* Maintain the project's intake queue and prioritization.
* Hold vendors and contractors to scope, schedule, and quality.
* Own the risk register and drive escalations to closure.
* Coordinate dependencies with the fiber build organization.
* Report status to the CTO, CEO, and finance.
* Travel to markets as business needs require.

  

**Success Profile**

* Organized leader with can do attitude and able to work across a wide variety of functions
* Holds vendors and internal teams to dates and scope.
* Systems thinking and technical enough to challenge engineers and contractors.
* Writes status an executive can act on quickly.

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8+ years in technical program management on network, systems or infrastructure programs, preferably at an ISP, carrier or MSP.
* Experience running migrations and cutovers on live networks with active subscribers.
* Scheduling, critical path, program controls, forecasting, and change control.
* Stage-gate governance and vendor and contractor management.
* Working knowledge of fixed wireless, IP networking, NMS/OSS/BSS platforms, and fiber access.
* ISP business knowledge: take rate, churn, cost per subscriber and payback.
* Preferred: acquisition integration at an ISP or carrier; NMS/OSS platform deployments; wireless capital programs; hands-on engineering background.
* Must reside in Nevada, California, Oregon, Missouri or New Mexico. Adjacent states may be considered for the right candidate.

  

**Physical Requirements**

* Extended periods working at a computer.
* Regular travel among markets for cutovers, project reviews and contractor oversight.
* Occasional lifting of equipment or materials up to 25 pounds.
* Site visits to data centers, tower sites and active project sites.

  

**Requirements**

* Stimulus Technologies conducts pre-employment and random background checks, along with drug, alcohol, and cannabis testing. Candidates must pass all required screenings.
* A valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record are required.

  

**Alignment with Core Values**

At Stimulus Technologies, our core values define how we work. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

* **Driven to Grow –** Continuously seeks to develop professionally, stays current with industry practices, and pushes to improve processes and outcomes.
* **See a Need – Fill a Need –** Proactively identifies gaps, obstacles, or opportunities and acts without waiting to be asked.
* **Elevate Others –** Mentors teammates, shares knowledge freely, and actively contributes to a positive and collaborative work environment.
* **Extreme Ownership –** Takes full accountability for results, decisions, and mistakes; does not deflect blame or make excuses.
* **Celebrate Success –** Recognizes contributions of team members, acknowledges milestones, and fosters a culture where wins are shared.

  

Stimulus Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Management reserves the right to change duties to meet business and organizational needs as needed.

jobs.title: Client Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**

KPA helps automotive businesses keep their people safe, protect their operations, and stay ahead of regulatory change with our 3 Pillars for Complete Compliance: Software, Consulting, and Training. Since 1986, KPA has helped automotive businesses navigate the complexities of compliance.  
  
Named as one of Built In Colorado’s Best Places to Work for seven years in a row, KPA is made up of talented individuals working together for the greater good. We’re here to help our clients build safe, thriving organizations, and we’re looking for people with a common goal to help us do it.

**About the Role:**
-------------------

A successful customer relationship starts with a strong implementation. At KPA, our Client Implementation Managers play a key role in making that happen, helping new customers get up and running with the tools they need to manage compliance, reduce risk, and operate more effectively.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, solving problems, and bringing structure to complex projects. You'll own the implementation process from initial planning and configuration through training and launch, helping customers navigate challenges and get the most out of KPA's solutions.

This role combines project management, technical problem-solving, and customer relationship management. You'll work closely with customers and internal teams to keep implementations moving forward, resolve roadblocks, and create a positive experience that sets the foundation for long-term success.

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Own the implementation process.** Manage new customer implementations from initial planning and site configuration through training, launch, and transition to ongoing support.
* **Build strong customer relationships.** Serve as a trusted point of contact throughout implementation, understanding customer needs, setting expectations, and helping them navigate the process.
* **Keep projects on track.** Develop and manage implementation plans, coordinate deliverables, identify potential risks, and proactively address issues that could impact timelines.
* **Configure solutions to meet customer needs.** Set up and configure KPA's platforms, providing guidance on product functionality, integrations, and best practices.
* **Solve problems creatively.** Work through implementation challenges, identify practical solutions using existing platform capabilities, and help customers overcome obstacles.
* **Help customers become confident users.** Train customer administrators and supervisors on how to effectively use KPA's products and manage their environments.
* **Collaborate across teams.** Partner with Client Success, Product, and Content teams to troubleshoot issues, share customer feedback, and improve the implementation experience.
* **Set customers up for long-term success.** Ensure implementations are completed successfully and customers experience a smooth transition to their ongoing Client Success team.

### **What You'll Bring:**

* At least 2 years of experience in a customer-facing role, ideally involving customer onboarding, implementation, project coordination, or technical support.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and keep projects moving forward.
* Confidence communicating with customers, understanding their needs, and guiding conversations toward solutions.
* A practical, resourceful approach to problem-solving, including the ability to work through unexpected challenges and remove roadblocks.
* Comfort learning new technology, explaining technical concepts, and helping others become confident using software platforms.
* The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with customers and teammates in a remote environment.
* Experience using Microsoft Office applications and customer relationship management tools.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

Nice to Have:

* Experience working with Salesforce.
* Previous experience implementing, configuring, or supporting software solutions.

### **What Success Looks Like:**

* Success in this role goes beyond completing implementations on time. It's about creating an experience where customers feel supported, understand how to use their solutions, and are confident moving forward.
* You'll be successful when you're able to independently manage implementations, build trust with customers, anticipate challenges before they become larger problems, and work effectively across teams to deliver a smooth onboarding experience.
* Above all, you'll bring a combination of accountability, curiosity, and a customer-first mindset to your work, helping KPA deliver on its commitment to making compliance simpler and more effective.

### **Compensation:**

* Base salary of 65-75k commensurate with experience
* Annual bonus up to 7.5%

### **Physical Requirements:**

Physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Visual Recognition - Constantly
* Stationary sitting or standing position - Constantly
* Working at a computer typing and view a screen - Constantly
* Speaking, Hearing, and Listening - Often

Don’t meet every job requirement? At KPA, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. Studies have shown some people are less likely to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you’re excited about the role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply! You might just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

As a growing company KPAvalues its employees by supporting them with a full benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, PTO, Paid and Floating

jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Spring Education Group is a national network of independent schools serving students from preschool through 12th grade. We believe that students can achieve more than they imagine. Each Spring school offers a carefully designed program led by expert educators who cultivate academic excellence, student independence, and a lasting love of learning. Our tuition-funded model allows our schools to create an open, transparent culture and a strong community, without the distractions of fundraising. We are building our network of schools to bring our distinctive approach to inspiring students to more families across America.
  
  
IT Project Manager – Spring Education Group
  
  
As an IT Project Manager at Spring Education Group, you will lead technology projects from planning through go-live and handoff to IT operations. You will manage scope, schedules, budgets, risks, and stakeholder communication for acquisition integrations, data migrations, platform rollouts, and infrastructure upgrades across our schools and brands.
  
  
You will partner with IT operations, shared services, academic and school leadership, and external vendors to deliver reliable systems that support students, families, and employees. You will adapt your project management approach to the work, build privacy and security requirements into project plans, and prepare school and business teams for each change.
  
  
Project Delivery and Portfolio Coordination
  

* Lead IT projects from initiation through completion: define scope, develop schedules and budgets, coordinate resources, and track milestones.
* Select and adapt Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, Kanban, PRINCE2, or hybrid delivery methods to fit each project and team.
* Maintain project plans, status reports, decision records, and RAID logs documenting risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects and help IT leadership prioritize the project portfolio.

Acquisition Integration and Data Migration
  

* Lead the IT workstream for acquisitions and divestitures, from due diligence and Day 1 readiness through full integration.
* Assess acquired schools’ systems, contracts, and security posture, and develop integration roadmaps.
* Coordinate identity, email, device, network, and application cutovers while minimizing disruption to students, families, and employees.
* Oversee data mapping, cleansing, validation, test loads, and migration cutovers.
* Establish reconciliation and sign-off criteria with data owners and maintain rollback plans.
* Protect sensitive student, employee, and financial data throughout each migration.

Technology Platforms and Infrastructure
  

* Manage Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 projects, including tenant consolidations, migrations, licensing changes, and new service rollouts.
* Lead ServiceNow projects involving new modules, workflows, service catalogs, and integrations in partnership with the platform team.
* Coordinate site build-outs, wide area network and local area network (WAN/LAN) upgrades, Wi-Fi improvements, firewall changes, and circuit transitions.

Compliance and Change Governance
  

* Build regulatory, privacy, and security requirements into project plans from the start.
* Partner with security and compliance teams on risk assessments, vendor reviews, and audit evidence.
* Follow change management processes and complete required documentation before go-live.

Stakeholder Communication and Vendor Management
  

* Serve as the primary project contact for sponsors, school leaders, and business teams, communicating progress, risks, and decisions clearly.
* Manage vendors and implementation partners against statements of work, schedules, and budgets.
* Coordinate communication and training so end users are prepared for new systems and processes.

Service Desk Readiness and Improvement
  

* Partner with the service desk to prepare for each launch, including ticket categories, routing, service level agreements (SLAs), knowledge articles, and staffing.
* Use incident, request, and problem trends to identify and scope improvement projects.
* Lead service desk improvements, including self-service portals, catalog redesigns, automation, and processes aligned with the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework.

What We’re Looking For
  
Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least five years of experience managing IT projects, including multiple projects running concurrently.
* Hands-on experience using more than one project management methodology, such as Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, Kanban, or hybrid approaches, with sound judgment about when to use each.
* Demonstrated delivery of at least one large data migration or system cutover.
* Working knowledge of Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 administration concepts, licensing, and migration paths.
* Solid understanding of network infrastructure fundamentals, including LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, firewalls, virtual private networks (VPNs), and internet service provider (ISP) circuits.
* Experience with project tracking tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, Microsoft Project, Asana, or ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including reporting project status and risks to senior leadership.
* At least two years working in or closely with an IT service desk, with a working understanding of incident, request, problem, and change management.
* Ability to manage vendors, contracts, and budgets.

Preferred Qualifications
  
Experience delivering projects under privacy, security, accessibility, or regulatory frameworks is a significant plus, including one or more of the following:
  

* Student and child privacy: Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA), Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), and state student data privacy laws such as California’s Student Online Personal I

Salary is commensurate with both location and experience.

Stanley Black & Decker is building an E-commerce Center of Excellence to share and implement best practices across our retailer-specific teams. As the E-commerce Project Manager, you will be responsible for project and operations management practices leading to efficiencies and increased productivity across the NA eCommerce team’s many work streams. Turning priorities into plans, keeping cross-functional teams aligned, and driving initiatives from kickoff to measurable results.

You will lead projects that touch some of the world's most trusted brands, including DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, STANLEY and BLACK+DECKER, across Amazon, The Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart, our direct-to-consumer sites and a broad network of commercial and industrial customers. Your work will lead to streamlined online product launches, stronger brand presence across dozens of retailer websites, and clearer visibility for leadership into where the next opportunities lie.

You’ll get to:

* Lead cross-retailer e-commerce initiatives end to end, including content refreshes for top-selling legacy products, SEO product improvement pipelines, and new and replacement content development.

* Coordinate new product launches so they go live on time with complete, high-quality content across every priority retailer.

* Manage multi-retailer reporting projects that give leadership a consistent view of performance and opportunities across channels.

* Build and maintain project plans, timelines, RAID logs and status reporting; keep work visible and moving.

* Partner closely with brand marketing, our creative studio, and sales and account teams, plus agency partners where needed, to align on scope, priorities and deliverables.

* Run effective meetings, drive decisions, and follow through on action items across teams that don't report to you.

* Identify risks and dependencies early, escalate thoughtfully, and propose solutions.

* Help document and scale the best practices the Center of Excellence develops, so retailer teams can adopt them consistently.

As you grow in the role, contribute to setting strategy and prioritizing the project portfolio  



**The Person:**

You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have:

* 3+ years of experience managing cross-functional projects from planning through delivery.

* Strong command of project management methodology: scoping, scheduling, resourcing, risk management, and status reporting.

* Proven stakeholder management skills, including influencing without direct authority and keeping senior leaders informed.

* Excellent organization and follow-through; you can juggle several concurrent projects without dropping details.

* Clear, concise written and verbal communication.

* Comfort working remotely with distributed teams and building relationships virtually.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.  



**The Details:**

You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including:

* Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being.
Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.  

**And More:**

We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:

* *Grow:* Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.
* *Learn:* Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.
* *Belong:* Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences.
* *Give Back:* Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!

jobs.description:
Overview:

LMI is seeking a **Project Manager / Scrum Mast**er at the senior level to lead Agile delivery in support of Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) technology modernization initiatives. This role combines hands-on Scrum leadership, integrated project planning, stakeholder coordination, and disciplined delivery management to help multidisciplinary teams deliver consistent outcomes while adopting enterprise work-management standards.

The Project Manager / Scrum Master will direct sprint and release cadence, translate objectives into actionable Jira backlogs and schedules, and coordinate dependencies across discovery, training, cloud configuration, migration, analytics, and organizational adoption activities. The successful candidate will establish clear delivery priorities, monitor quality and capacity, and provide timely, decision-ready reporting on progress, blockers, and risk.

This is not a meeting-facilitation-only role. The project manager must make tradeoffs visible, remove impediments, align delivery plans with stakeholder readiness, and follow issues through resolution. Strong judgment, practical familiarity with Agile delivery, and an ability to communicate with both technical teams and senior leaders are essential.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

* Establish transparent controls for scope, assumptions, risk, change requests, action items, and lessons learned without introducing unnecessary administrative burden.
* Monitor sprint predictability, blocked work, aging items, workload, throughput, and planned-versus-completed deliverables; use trends to drive constructive improvement discussions.
* Coordinate readiness and approval checkpoints with customer decision-makers before onboarding teams or transitioning configurations and data.

* PMP or PMI-ACP certification; Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) a plus.
* Experience leading Agile delivery with Jira Cloud, workflows, plans, reports, and dependency management.
* Strong facilitation, executive communication, risk management, and cross-functional coordination skills.

* Demonstrated ability to manage schedule and delivery risks, coordinate multiple interdependent teams, and produce accurate executive-level status reporting.

**Desired:**

* Federal enterprise IT modernization, Atlassian implementation (Commercial Cloud preferred), or cloud-migration experience.
* Experience supporting portfolio governance and scaled Agile reporting. Jira Align experience / implementation a differentiator

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Evaluate warehouse, transportation, distribution, packaging, material flow, and inbound/outbound logistics capabilities; identify capacity gaps and corrective actions  

  

**Operational Excellence**

jobs.title: Program Manager or Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
**Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager – Energy Star Team**

**Help us certify high-performance buildings that cut energy use and carbon emissions.**

Southern Energy Management is a certified B Corporation on a mission to improve the way people make and use energy. Since 2001, we've been proving that businesses can be a force for good—and we've been recognized as an INC Best Place to Work for making that journey rewarding for our team.

We're looking for a building performance professional to join our Multifamily and Commercial Energy Services Team as either a **Program Manager** or **Assistant Program Manager**. Whether you're a seasoned rater ready to lead projects or an emerging professional with field testing experience ready to level up, there's a place for you here.

**Location:** Remote (Ideally NC, SC, VA)

**Employment Type:** Full-time, salaried, exempt

**What You'll Do**

You'll own Energy Star & Earthcraft certification projects from enrollment to final certification—guiding multifamily developers and builders through the technical requirements while ensuring buildings perform as designed. Your energy modeling reviews, field verifications, and technical problem-solving directly determine whether buildings earn the Energy Star or Earthcraft labels.

**Your day-to-day:**

* Manage Energy Star Multifamily New Construction and Earthcraft certification projects from design through completion
* Review and validate residential energy models to ensure accuracy and program compliance
* Conduct field inspections (up to 20% of your time) and performance testing at construction sites
* Be the technical expert your project teams rely on—developers, architects, builders, and engineers
* Troubleshoot compliance issues and provide creative solutions to meet certification targets
* Coordinate with field technicians on inspection scheduling and corrective work
* Track project milestones, invoices, and deliver proactive client updates
* Collaborate with a supportive team that values technical excellence and continuous learning

**We're Hiring Two Levels**

**Program Manager** (63,000–78,000)

* RESNET, Energy Star credentials (SFNH or MFNC) & Earthcraft TA strongly preferred
* Experience with LEED, Fitwel, Green Globes and Life Cycle Analysis is also a great asset
* 3–5 years in field verification, energy rating, or green building certification
* Strong working knowledge of residential energy modeling (ekotrope, REM/Rate, or similar)
* Bachelor's degree in building science, construction, sustainability, architecture, or related field
* Demonstrated ability to review energy models and catch discrepancies

**Assistant Program Manager** (48,000–63,000)

* 1–3 years in field testing, green building programs, or energy rating
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
* Experience with blower door testing, duct testing, or other diagnostic equipment preferred
* Familiarity with energy modeling software helpful (we'll train you)
* RESNET or other green building credentials a plus—we'll support your professional development

**Both roles require:**

* Technical understanding of building science fundamentals and HVAC systems
* Strong communication skills for explaining complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
* Excellent organization and attention to detail—accuracy matters in energy ratings
* Comfort with Google Workspace and Asana, and ability to learn energy modeling software
* Willingness to travel occasionally for field inspections across NC, SC, and VA

**About You**

You're detail-oriented and technically curious. You get excited about building performance data and love solving the puzzle of how to make buildings more efficient. You're an "ideal team player"—humble, hungry, and smart (in the emotional intelligence sense). You want your work to have measurable environmental impact. You’re passionate about sustainability.

**Why Join Us?**

**Mission that matters.** Energy Star and Earthcraft buildings use significantly less energy, reducing carbon emissions and utility costs for residents.

**Growth-focused culture.** We invest in a Team Member’s credentials, relevant training, and career development. The majority of our Guidance Team (Senior Management Team) started in entry level roles.

**Technical community.** You'll work alongside experienced raters, modelers, and building science professionals who love geeking out about building science.

**Real benefits.** Comprehensive health insurance, 401(k) matching, progressive PTO, professional development budget (including certification costs), and more.

**Flexibility.** Work remotely from North Carolina, South Carolina, or Virginia.

**Ready to Apply?**

We're reviewing applications and scheduling interviews as they come in, so if this role excites you, don't wait. The sooner you apply, the sooner we can start a conversation.

SEM values diversity and inclusion. We strongly encourage applications from women, BIPOC, and LGBTQIA+ candidates. We're committed to bringing historically disenfranchised voices to the forefront of climate and energy justice work.

Apply today and help us lead the change.

After reviewing the job ad and Quiktrak’s website, select one responsibility from the ad that best matches your experience. Describe one specific example in which you performed similar work.

* Explain the situation, your individual responsibility, and the deliverable or recommendation you produced.

-

**About Quiktrak**  
Quiktrak provides floor plan audit and asset-verification services for banks, captive finance companies, independent lenders, and dealer networks across industries such as powersports, marine, recreational vehicles, transportation, and construction equipment.

Our Checks platform is changing how client audit programs are configured, implemented, validated, and supported. The Business Analyst works at the intersection of client needs, operational realities, system behavior, and product decisions.

**About the Role**  
Quiktrak is seeking a Business Analyst to turn business, client, and operational needs into clear configuration decisions, testable system requirements, and reliable solutions in Checks and related Quiktrak systems.

You must be able to schedule work and meetings across Quiktrak's national business window, generally between 6:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time (9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Eastern Time), depending on team and client needs. Continuous availability across the full window is not expected, but reliable overlap with both Eastern and Pacific business hours is required.

During client onboarding and migration, your primary output will be the Validation Menu: the decision record that captures Quiktrak's recommendations, selected options, configuration choices, non-workflow requirements, open items, dependencies, and follow-up. You will keep that record current as decisions move through configuration, testing, and implementation.

This is a judgment-intensive role, not a note-taking position. You will diagnose needs, recommend supportable options, surface ambiguity before it becomes rework, troubleshoot complex issues, validate delivered solutions, and use evidence to improve both products and implementation practices.

**How the Role Fits the Implementation Team**  
You will work alongside an Implementation Analyst. The Implementation Analyst owns documentation of a client's audit workflows in the Checks platform. You will own the Validation Menu, non-workflow requirements and configuration analysis, acceptance criteria, integrated validation, and the Business Analyst workstream.

You should be able to understand and review workflow logic, identify gaps between approved decisions and the build, and complete a contained workflow task with review when needed. Workflow development is a secondary capability, not the primary purpose of the role.

* Configure or coordinate settings, reports, permissions, visibility, integrations, data exchange, and related system functions.
* Identify conflicting inputs, downstream effects, risks, and missing decisions before configuration or development begins.
* Balance client needs with platform standards, scalability, operational impact, future maintenance, and supportability.

  

*Provide Tier 2 Technical Analysis*

**About Wolf Electric Supply Company**

Wolf Electric Supply Company specializes in electrical wholesale distribution, providing electrical materials, equipment, and related products to contractors and businesses involved in commercial and industrial construction. Its product offerings include lighting fixtures, electrical wire, conduit, switchgear, fittings, and other essential electrical supplies used in construction and infrastructure projects.

The company's operations depend on efficient inventory management, accurate purchasing records, reliable supplier relationships, and organized distribution processes to support customer orders and construction project requirements.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Electrical Distribution Operations Analyst to help monitor, evaluate, and improve operational activities across inventory management, purchasing, warehouse operations, order fulfilment, and product distribution. This position is ideal for an analytical professional with experience in operations reporting, inventory analysis, supply chain coordination, business data analysis, or distribution operations who wants to build a career in the electrical wholesale distribution industry.

**Job Summary**

Wolf Electric Supply Company is seeking an Electrical Distribution Operations Analyst who will support the collection, analysis, monitoring, and reporting of operational data related to electrical product inventory, purchasing activities, supplier performance, warehouse operations, customer orders, and distribution processes.

Working with sales, purchasing, warehouse, inventory management, logistics, and accounting teams, the analyst will help ensure that operational information is accurate, accessible, and useful for evaluating business performance and identifying opportunities for improvement.

The position will involve reviewing inventory movement, tracking order fulfilment, monitoring product availability, preparing operational reports, and identifying inefficiencies that may affect purchasing decisions, material availability, and customer delivery schedules.

This is an entry-level opportunity for someone with strong analytical and organizational skills who understands the importance of accurate operational data and efficient distribution processes. Previous experience in electrical distribution or construction supplies is helpful but not required.

**Why Join Our Team?**

* Join Wolf Electric Supply Company and build your career in the electrical wholesale distribution and construction supply industry while contributing to efficient business operations and distribution performance. You'll gain hands-on experience analysing inventory records, purchasing activities, warehouse operations, supplier performance, and customer order fulfilment while developing valuable skills in operational reporting, data analysis, inventory management, and process improvement.
* Work alongside sales, purchasing, warehouse, logistics, and operations teams to identify inefficiencies, improve material availability, and support reliable product distribution. Gain practical knowledge of electrical supply operations, contractor purchasing requirements, and the movement of electrical materials from suppliers to customers.

jobs.title: Customer Deployment Manager
jobs.description:
**About Endra**

Every building is designed twice. The architect shapes what you see. MEP engineers design everything that makes it work: the power, air and water behind every hospital, data centre and home. It's a $150 billion industry still run on manual work and decades-old tools, and it's running out of engineers just as the world needs more buildings than ever.

We're building the platform that changes that. Endra's takes over the repetitive work so engineers can do what they're trained for: judgment and design. Some of the world's most respected engineering firms, including AtkinsRéalis, Ramboll, Buro Happold, Hoare Lea, Tetra Tech, AFRY and Rejlers, already build with us.

Since 2024, we've raised $75 million from Andreessen Horowitz, Notion Capital and Norrsken VC, and grown into a team across Stockholm, Zurich, London, New York and San Francisco. We're early, moving fast and setting out to change how the world's buildings get designed.

We're looking for people who care deeply about their craft, take ownership of complex problems, push us to think bigger, and are driven to create something with lasting impact.

**About the role**

For us, a signed contract is the starting line. The moment a customer signs, Customer Deployment takes over, and our job is to make Endra the way their engineers actually work as soon as possible.

As Customer Deployment Manager, you'll own that journey for some of our most important customers: large engineering consultancies with many offices, hundreds of engineers, and a long list of stakeholders who all need to say yes. You'll be the project lead for each rollout. You set up the structure, drive adoption, clear the roadblocks, and make the value impossible to miss.

You'll work hand in hand with our product specialists who are MEP engineers: they bring the MEP depth, you bring the structure and the commercial lens. Together you'll help engineers who have worked the same way for decades adopt a new one.

**What you'll do**.

* **Own onboarding and rollout.** Lead on-site and remote onboarding with our product specialists so MEP engineers get up and running fast and deliver real results using Endra on their very first project. You own the plan and the milestones, and you keep every stakeholder moving.
* **Work every stakeholder.** Cover everyone from the CEO and heads of discipline to BIM managers, IT and the engineers on the project. Keep them involved at the right moments, and turn early users into champions who train their colleagues.
* **Measure and report the wins.** Agree on success criteria with each customer, track adoption and account health, and act on risk early. Turn the results into clear wins for their leadership and for Endra.
* **Clear the roadblocks.** Spot what's stalling early, whether it's technical, organizational, or a skeptical team. Bring in the right people and see it through.
* **Find the next opportunity.** Uncover new teams, offices and use cases, and support account managers with further growing the customer accounts.
* **Shape the product.** Bring structured insight from the field to product and engineering, so what we build next is what customers need.
* **Build the playbook.** Our deployment function is young. You'll define how Endra rolls out, measures and reports, and set the standard the team scales on.

**Who you are**

* You've run or played a key role in enterprise software rollouts, with 3–5 years of client-facing experience in customer success, implementation or management consulting, ideally in a complex, expert-driven industry.
* You've driven change management before and know that getting a large organization onto new technology is as much about people as about software.
* You're structured and organized, and you stay calm when there are many moving parts.
* You take ownership, and your track record shows it in results delivered and responsibilities that grew.
* You have commercial instinct. You know adoption drives renewal and expansion, and you think about the customer's business case, not only usage numbers.
* You're an excellent communicator, in writing and in the room, and a team player who makes the people around you better.
* You’re comfortable building as you go, improving a playbook rather than just following it.

**How we think and work**

* Less is more: We simplify and ship smaller, fast.
* Build the right things: We listen carefully and build what users actually need.
* Velocity & Quality: We build things that last, but we don’t perfect them forever.
* Trust & Collaboration: Strong opinions, loosely held.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and equity.
* Employee-friendly equity terms.
* Private health insurance.
* Regular team events and off-sites.
* An inspiring, ambitious, and global work environment.

**Ready to move the needle?**

Do you feel this is your opportunity to do your most meaningful work and reshape an entire industry? Let's talk!

Compensation Range: $140K - $190K

The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**

Vestwell is expanding and we're keen to find and hire a new analyst onto our data squad. Are you good with numbers? Do you ask lots of questions to understand something to its root? If you answered in the affirmative, then maybe you have what it takes to join VUDU squad. Our team is passionate about data and logic, and we cover every aspect of data analysis and observational reporting from AI-powered BI agents to enterprise feed automation.

We're looking for someone who loves to solve problems and wants to learn how to build out great data-product solutions. You will work with senior members of the squad translating end-user needs into focused, actionable steps that result in timely solution deliveries. You will learn and execute our requirement-intake processes, and implement new solutions using our data stack to solve for those requirements. But that is just the start, while you learn our process, you will be expected to carry forward your knowledge and work with the larger team learning to build AI-powered solutions that scale for long term growth and expand our group's bandwidth across the organization.

If you are someone who dives into whatever challenge is placed in front of you, you will find endless challenge at Vestwell on the VUDU squad; the good kind that leaves you a little winded but much the wiser. We are not an old-school financial company. We are disruptors. We use state of the art tools and we work to win.

**What Will You Be Doing?**

* Understand project goals and stakeholder requirements; identify opportunities; and translate inputs into buildable features with clear executions
* Effectively communicate and share plans and decisions: in and out, up and down
* Partner with developers to break down product requirements into discrete tasks with clear functional requirements/acceptance criteria
* Assist QA team in understanding the appropriate positive and negative test cases to ensure test coverage and a high level of code quality
* Provide iterative feedback to the development team, including identifying bugs and assisting in resolution
* Complete functional testing and provide initial product sign-off when features are ready for end-user verification

The Necessities

* College degree
* Business / Math degree
* Ability to thoroughly understand and document business/functional requirements and use cases
* Working understanding or the SDLC
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, project-oriented environment to meet deadlines under tight time constraints
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment consisting of Product, Engineering, and QA resources
* Excellent communication skills, both in verbal and written formats
* Must have the ability to interface with internal stakeholders
* Experience with SQL, must be able to read it and write it to some provable extent

This role will be based in either the New York, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

The expected base salary range for this position is $70K - $80K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**  
We're an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

**Interview Process**  
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

jobs.description:
Job ID

JR109127

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

The Logistics Security Program Manager plays a critical role in creating, applying, and improving Micron’s high-value logistics security efforts. This role centers on protecting high-value and high-risk shipments by defining risk-based security controls, boosting cargo-level visibility, tracking carrier and third-party logistics provider performance, and leading responses to customer concerns throughout global transportation networks. The program manager partners with Global Security, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Legal, Risk, and external logistics providers to ensure Micron operates a scalable, auditable, and response-ready model for high-value shipments. This role specifically covers program management in the Americas and Europe.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Serve as the subject matter expert for high-value logistics security, coordinating global transportation lanes, carriers, freight forwarders, and 3PL partners.
* Develop and uphold risk-focused logistics security frameworks and control strategies for valuable and sensitive shipments spanning various regions, routes, and transportation methods.
* Establish security requirements for carriers and logistics providers, including tracking, geofencing, chain of custody, tamper detection, monitoring, addressing critical issues, recovery, and compliance controls.
* Partner with Procurement, Logistics, Global Security, Legal, and business collaborators to integrate security requirements into contracts, operating procedures, supplier expectations, and governance processes.
* Evaluate and implement logistics security technologies and vendor solutions, including telematics, embedded tracking, smart seals, monitoring platforms, and recovery services across multimodal transportation networks.
* Lead logistics security vendor assessments, pilots, implementations, and ongoing performance management to ensure effective execution, integration, monitoring, and service delivery.
* Conduct carrier and lane risk assessments, manage incident response and recovery efforts, and coordinate monitoring, customer concern handling, law enforcement coordination, evidence preservation, and after-action reviews.
* Measure program efficiency through security metrics, compliance monitoring, audits, policies, playbooks, supplier scorecards, and executive-level risk reporting to drive continuous improvement and security maturity.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, Security Management, Risk Management, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
* Experience developing and managing logistics security, transportation risk, supply chain security, cargo protection, and high-value shipment programs with expertise in carrier management and security operations.
* Proven knowledge of shipment security controls, including cargo tracking, telematics, geofencing, route management, smart seals, tamper detection, monitoring, addressing critical issues, and recovery operations.
* Experience conducting risk assessments, managing vendors and supplier performance, analyzing security metrics and trends, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives across multimodal logistics networks.
* Strong understanding of industry security frameworks (TAPA, CTPAT), cargo theft prevention, incident response, and working closely with Procurement, Logistics, Global Security, Legal, business leaders, external partners, and executive collaborators.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Supply Chain, Security, Risk Management, Business Operations, or a related area, with industry-recognized certifications such as TAPA, CPP, PSP, CTPAT, ASIS, or equivalent preferred.
* Outstanding executive communication abilities with a talent for converting complex logistics security risks into clear recommendations, briefings, incident updates, and decision-ready materials for varied audiences.
* Proven ability to lead through fast paced security incidents using strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk-based decision-making capabilities.
* Demonstrated success building positive relationships across internal collaborators, carriers, 3PLs, security providers, and external partners while driving accountability for security outcomes.
* Strong background in program management with the skills to balance security, operational feasibility, cost, scalability, customer commitments, and business continuity needs while employing AI-based tools intended to advance risk analysis, trend identification, and decision-making.

$165,000.00 - $281,000.00 a year

Additional compensation may include benefits, bonuses and equity.

**Summary**
-----------

This position is located at Departmental Offices,Terrorism and Financial Intelligence - Intelligence Analysis. As an Intelligence Analyst, you will provide intelligence and research support to senior Treasury officials concerning threats to the national security, foreign policy, or economy of the United States.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Clarification from the agency**

U.S. citizens or U.S. Nationals; no prior Federal experience is required.

  

**Duties**
----------

*Pursuant to 50 USC 3024 (v), and with concurrence and consultation with the Director of National Intelligence and the Director of the Office of Personnel Management, this position is being established in the excepted service as an element of the Intelligence Community within the Department of the Treasury.*  
  
The following are the duties of this position at the GS-13. If you are selected at a lower grade level, you will have the opportunity to learn to perform all these duties, and will receive training to help you grow in this position.
  
  

* The incumbent is responsible for performing a broad range of analytical and short-suspense assignments involving economic, financial, and all-source intelligence analysis on the structure and operations of foreign terrorist and illicit finance networks, their vulnerabilities, and the application or impact of Treasury authorities used to target them. Associated duties include; identifying information gaps and intelligence requirements; reconciling occasionally conflicting data sources; collaborating with Intelligence Community counterparts to author finished intelligence products on topics including, but not limited to international banking and international trade sectors as well as foreign terrorist and illicit finance networks; and providing verbal, written, and graphical presentation of results to Treasury, Intelligence Community, U.S. Government interagency, and foreign government audiences. The incumbent assists the Office Director and Deputy Director as well as other OIA management in sharing relevant information and analysis developed by OIA with U.S. regulatory, diplomatic, defense, intelligence, and law enforcement communities, in accordance with applicable policy and security guidelines.

  

* The incumbent represents the organization at Intelligence Community and interagency meetings and may be required to travel both domestically and abroad. * The incumbent is responsible for regularly briefing working-level policy and enforcement counterparts, as well a senior-level Treasury officials at the Deputy Assistant Secretary (DAS) level and providing subject matter expertise that informs Treasury decisionmakers.

----------------

Each year, institutional investors such as mutual funds and pension funds vote on key governance issues at their portfolio companies. For over 40 years, Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) has been the leading provider of governance research to institutional investors, helping them assess governance risk in their portfolios and cast informed votes on these issues.

**Responsibilities**

* Perform research and complete proxy analyses for shareholder meetings of publicly traded companies.
* Read and understand SEC filings (10-Ks, 10-Qs, 8-Ks, DEF 14As) and other company disclosures and distill financial, industry, and corporate governance information to draft analyses and issue proxy vote recommendations based on ISS' policy guidelines (available at ihttps://www.iss-stoxx.com/stewardship/voting-policy-gateway/proxy-voting-policies/).
* Develop understanding of governance issues, in particular those dealing with equity or debt financings.
* Answer internal and external queries on research analyses, and discuss policies and vote recommendations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or higher, plus relevant work experience preferred in finance, accounting, economics, governance, or law.
* Strong analytical abilities.
* Excellent writing and oral communication skills.
* Organizational skills, attention to detail, a self-driven work ethic, and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
* Ability to work within a team-oriented environment and communicate with various internal parties.

Description Senior Associate, Project Manager - Commercial Digital Banking Well Managed Team

**About the Role:**
  
As the Sr. Project Manager on Digital Banking’s Well Managed Team, you will work directly with leaders in product, tech, design, and the enterprise to develop, deliver, and sustain our digital banking well-managed agenda. You will leverage your project, process, and risk management skills to ensure we maintain compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements. The role will work directly with product managers, software engineers, risk and compliance partners along with data teams to develop and monitor a well-managed operation.

  
  

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

  
  

**On any given day you will be:**

* Overseeing the project management lifecycle for control-related initiatives, ensuring timely execution, clear communication, and adherence to quality standards.
* Solving complex problems and consulting on new capabilities by leveraging your subject matter expertise.
* Building, enhancing, and managing processes and controls to ensure the day-to-day delivery of key functions.
* Driving the implementation of preventive controls to minimize risk events and improve operational efficiency.
* Partnering with Risk Management to identify, assess, and mitigate potential risks involving data management and data movement systems.
* Collaborating with Product Management and Technology teams to integrate effective controls into the design and development of new and existing features.
* Influencing management through the effective presentation of insights and recommendations for improvement.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**

* **Monitoring and Metrics for digital platform** releases as well as BAU to all LOB heads and other stakeholders
  + **Performance Monitoring**: Contribute to monitoring the performance of the digital banking platforms, services, and processes against framework guidelines and established metrics.
  + **Performance Metrics**: Establish key technical, client, and associate metrics reviewed on a set cadence to ensure the platform is operating optimally. Where metrics indicate an opportunity for improvement or escalation, manage to closure.
  + **Monthly Business Review (MBR)**: Author and coordinate monthly development and submission of Digital Banking Team’s MBR for stakeholders
  + **Associate and client experience feedback**: Co-lead data collection, LT reporting, and initiative prioritization for our digital platforms
* **Streamlined management and oversight** for compliance, process, risk and regulatory reporting impacting the program - controls, L1 - L4 process maps, risk findings, etc.
  + **Process Optimization**: Identify opportunities for process improvement within the framework, contributing to the development and implementation of optimized workflows for areas such as platform management and maintenance, fraud, business operations, and cyber/security operations.
  + **Documentation and Standards**: Assist in the creation and maintenance of documentation, policies, and standards related to the digital banking platforms (e.g., IT governance, data management, project management, release management).
  + **Compliance and Risk Support**: Support efforts related to compliance management, risk management, regulatory agencies, and internal controls.
* **Vendor Management Support**: Assist in supporting vendor performance and portfolio management activities as they relate to the overall framework.
* **Operational Monitoring & Control Testing**: Execute monitoring of control reporting and investigations to rule-out issues, including direct outreach to partners and associates and conducting root cause research for system/process breakdowns.
  + These efforts are leveraged to identify sustainable systemic enhancements that drive automation and ownership.
  + Supporting end-to-end testing of controls by planning and executing required test process steps.
  + Assessing the operational and design effectiveness of automated, hybrid, and manual controls.
  + Creating and maintaining adequate testing support documentation (BRDs, rationale, finding/issues reports).
* **Quality & Remediation**: Identifying internal control weaknesses and recommending remediation to strengthen the control environment.
* **Risk Event Management**: Serving as a Business Lead to identify, contain, and remediate issues in accordance with the Enterprise Risk Event standard, ensuring customers are made whole within a timely manner.
  + This includes coordinating fixes with key parties, maintaining open communication with the Event Management team, and actively participating in risk mitigation and recovery efforts.
  + Driving risk-related projects based on defined priorities to ensure scope, timelines, and deliverables are met while proactively identifying risks and mitigating or escalating as needed.

  

**Role-Based Competencies:**

* **Intellectually Curious**. You’re comfortable navigating between the big ideas and executional realities to create an achievable strategic semantics vision. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.
* **Communicator & Influencer**. You’re comfortable influencing a group of executives as well as communicating your semantics vision clearly to your associates and partners. You can be open to different communication styles and listen carefully to diverse sets of ideas.
* **Do-er.** You’re biased toward action, and are willing to make commitments and trade-offs with other leaders to remove impediments for your team; you are a leader obsessed with delivering value in an iterative way focusing in minimum viable product

jobs.description:
**Short Description:**

The DCAS Program at DHCF is looking for a highly experienced project manager to execute the DCAS project manager lifecycle. Only local candidates to DMV area will be considered.

**Complete Description:**

DHCF is looking for a Project manager to support the PMO of the DCAS program. This self-motivated and passionate individual will assist the team in meeting critical milestones and proactively notifies team of obstacles with solutions to ensure the team's success. They must also be a Champion for change as required while at the same time be able to meet the needs of the business while partnering with leaders in other areas like Operations, Quality and Technical Operations.
  
  
This candidate will also be required to maintain high quality and compliance standards, while planning and executing the project.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
  

* Lead the design, implementation and maintenance of the project portfolio process and drive the integration and alignment for the project management process
* Accountable and owner of several key PMO processes including management of program scope and schedule, project status reporting, executive leadership reporting, dependency management, issue and risk management, and project communications.
* Build working relationships at all levels of the organization to partner with and effectively communicate with cross-functional groups as required
* Foster a climate of open communication, engagement and ownership within the team
* Accountable for ensuring that deliverables from business and technology partners are produced and approved according to multiple project schedules. This includes requirement documents, functional and technical design documents, test plans, etc.
* Drives project workstreams, developing, executing, tracking, and monitoring plans, resolving blockers, and ensuring ongoing alignment with program priorities

  

* Works collaboratively with business leaders, project leaders, and impacted external stakeholders, coordinating efforts across those groups to analyze and assess readiness for change.
* Assures compliance with CMS and FNS requirements
* Coordinate and communicate stakeholders as needed to set and manage expectations, highlight and resolve issues and ensure an overall excellent experience working with the PMO team
* Represents project in executive-level presentations in various project governance and inter-departmental meetings.
* Maintain a project schedule ensuring task specific project schedules are added to the integrated master scheduled.
* Accountable and responsible that all relevant processes are executed and in compliance for the team and organization
* Responsible for ensuring all business readiness is implemented including any necessary training and updates to business processes.
* Ensure clear identification of goals and the benefits to be realized as part of the Project Portfolio commitment to Business goals and objectives
* Lead periodic reviews of continuous projects portfolio, business benefits realized, key performance indicators and gaps
* Advanced ability to identify, develop and quantify any required corrective action plans
* Advanced ability to ensure that effective project controls are in place to monitor project or program performance
* Ability to work with business partners and program management team on development of LTC practices, policies, guidelines, and operational processes.
* Effective communication to all levels or the organization, including effectively presenting information and responding to questions or complex inquiries from groups of employees, managers and internal customers, influencing leadership and facilitation skills and working at functional and strategic levels simultaneously
* Monitor and direct day-to-day operations of the assigned tasks to ensure that policies and procedures are being followed, that contract and client goals and objectives are met, and that services and projects are being accomplished effectively and efficiently.
* Drives execution discipline across teams ensuring deviations to standards and metric targets have clear action plans and follow-ups
* Develops project schedules, cross-functional deliverables, and detailed timelines, as well as identifies and manages project priorities and cross-project dependencies
* Accountable for and leads other project managers on highly complex project.

Ensures the project is successful from start to finish.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
  
1. Formulates and defines systems scope and objectives based on both user needs and a thorough understanding of business systems and industry requirements.
  
2. Devises or modifies procedures to solve complex problems considering computer equipment capacity and limitations, operation time, and form of desired results. Includes analysis of business and user needs, documentation of requirements, and translation into proper system requirements specifications.
  
3. Provides consultation on complex projects and is considered to be the top level contributor/specialist of most phases of systems analysis, while considering the business implications of the application of technology to the current and future business environment.
  
  
**Minimum Education/Certification Requirements :**  
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field or equivalent experience;  
A current Project Management Professional Certification is highly desired  
  
This position is onsite.

**Technical Project Manager IV&V Program**

**Work Location: This is a Hybrid position at 200 Independence Ave SW, Washington, DC 20201** at our federal client office in Washington, DC. In the future, two days per week will be based at the Areeva office.

***We prefer D.C. Metro area Candidates with U.S. Citizenship or a Green Card due to the clearance requirements on federal contracts.***

Areeva Solutions, LLC is seeking an experienced **Program Manager / IV&V Program Lead** who is accountable for the successful management and coordinated execution of Areeva’s HHS Systems IV&V contract. The role serves as the primary contractor interface with the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), leads contract governance and reporting, directs a cross-functional technical, functional, financial, and program support team, and ensures work remains aligned to the Statement of Work, schedule, quality standards, and approved customer priorities. The position also leads the evolution of IV&V toward a scalable, risk-based, evidence-driven oversight model across DIS systems and modernization initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide overall leadership, governance, and operational oversight for the IV&V contract; serve as the primary contractor point of contact to the COR and customer stakeholders.
* Plain, assign, coordinate, and monitor work across technical IV&V, functional verification, financial management, risk management, reporting, records, and program administration.
* Maintain the Project Management Plan and Task Management Plan, including schedules, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, staffing assumptions, and operational priorities.
* Lead recurring governance activities, including team stand-ups, Technical Management Reviews, PM/COR touchpoints, modernization coordination, and cross-organizational working sessions.
* Own or provide final management review for contract deliverables, including Weekly Activity Reports, Quarterly Status Reports, TMP updates, risk reports, executive briefings, meeting minutes, and supporting documentation; coordinate Financial Status Report review.
* Monitor contract performance, staffing, resource utilization, schedules, risks, issues, action items, and scope alignment; escalate concerns and recommend corrective or mitigating actions.
* Lead stakeholder, transition, onboarding, access, knowledge-transfer, document-transfer, and continuity activities across DIS, PMO, vendors, modernization teams, financial stakeholders, and Areeva leadership.
* Direct IV&V modernization and continuous improvement through independent oversight, evidence validation, risk-based prioritization, SDLC and release-readiness reviews, performance monitoring, functionality mapping, dashboards, and executive reporting.
* Oversee project records, SharePoint repositories, permissions, document control, quality review, Section 508 considerations, and compliance with contract, security, privacy, and records requirements.
* Supervise assigned employees and contractors through work direction, coaching, workload management, timesheet/PTO review, performance discussions, cross-training, and continuity planning; support proposals, recompetes, and contract-growth initiatives as assigned.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, public administration, information systems, project management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
* At least 10 years of progressively responsible program or project management experience, including leadership of complex federal technology, grants-management, modernization, IV&V, or mission-support initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary teams, customer relationships, contract deliverables, schedules, risks, staffing, and executive reporting in a federal environment.
* Working knowledge of IV&V principles, SDLC governance, Agile delivery, test and release oversight, risk management, performance measurement, and evidence-based assurance.
* Ability to translate complex technical, financial, operational, and policy information into concise plans, decisions, briefings, and recommendations for technical and executive audiences.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Lists, and collaborative document management; familiarity with Jira, dashboards/analytics, and automated-testing concepts is beneficial.
* Ability to obtain and maintain required federal suitability, public-trust credentials, PIV access, and system access; must comply with NDA, security, privacy, records, and standards-of-conduct requirements.
* This is a Hybrid position, with federal client office in Washington, DC. In the future, two days per week will be based at the Areeva office.
* Compensation will be based on experience, skills, and expertise, and will fall within the range provided.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Clearance and pass a drug and background check.
* Areeva Solutions, LLC. participates in the E-Verify program as required by law.

**Preferred Skills**

* PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, ITIL, or comparable program/project management credential.
* Experience supporting HHS, the Office of Grants, Grants.gov, GrantSolutions, TAGGS, or federal shared-service environments.
* Experience with federal contracting, COR-facing delivery, key-personnel responsibilities, Section 508, CPIC, OMB policy impacts, financial oversight, and government reporting cycles.
* Experience designing or implementing risk-based IV&V, automated testing, continuous monitoring, release-readiness, or modernization-governance models.
