jobs.title: Data Center Project Manager (Critical Infrastructure), Critical Projects Implementation
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operation data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced and proactive Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system. The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.
  
  
If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think big; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon data centers then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!  
  
This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
* Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

You will work closely with IT, infrastructure and security teams to investigate incidents, improve threat detection and maintain effective security monitoring procedures. * Monitor security alerts, network activity, endpoints and system logs to identify potential threats.
* Investigate suspicious events, determine their severity and establish appropriate response priorities.
* Lead or support security incident investigations from initial detection through resolution.
* Analyse security data to identify attack patterns, vulnerabilities and unusual system behaviour.
* Conduct threat hunting activities to identify risks that may not trigger standard security alerts.
* Use security monitoring and incident management tools to investigate potential compromises.
* Coordinate containment, remediation and recovery activities with relevant technical teams.
* Review and improve security detection rules, alert thresholds and monitoring procedures.
* Maintain detailed records of incidents, investigation findings and corrective actions.
* Prepare security reports and communicate technical risks to management and relevant stakeholders.
* Support vulnerability assessments, security reviews and internal audit requirements.
* Identify recurring security issues and recommend measures to reduce future exposure.
* Help develop incident response procedures and operational documentation.
* Provide technical guidance to junior security analysts and support knowledge sharing within the team.

**What We're Looking For**

* Professional experience in security operations, cybersecurity analysis or a related information security role.
* Strong understanding of security monitoring, threat detection and incident response.
* Experience analysing security alerts, system logs and network activity.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms, endpoint detection tools and security monitoring technologies.
* Knowledge of common cyber threats, attack methods and defensive security practices.
* Understanding of network security, endpoint protection, identity management and access controls.
* Ability to investigate incidents, identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
* Experience preparing technical incident reports and maintaining investigation records.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities during security incidents.
* Professional judgement when handling confidential information and sensitive security findings.

**What We Expect**

We expect thorough investigations, accurate incident records and timely communication when security risks are identified. Findings should be supported by evidence, response actions should follow established procedures and unresolved issues should receive appropriate attention.

The successful candidate should remain composed during incidents, take responsibility for assigned investigations and communicate technical findings in straightforward language. We also value the ability to guide junior analysts and work collaboratively with other technical teams.

jobs.title: Strategy & Business Operations Manager, Wolt Drive
jobs.description:
**About Wolt**
--------------

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.  
  
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

**About the role**
------------------

Wolt is on a growth journey as part of the DoorDash family, together with Deliveroo. **Drive** is our delivery-as-a-service business: we let merchants offer fast, reliable delivery in their own channels (their webshop, app or ordering system), powered by the Wolt and Deliveroo courier networks. We're now bringing Drive across Wolt and Deliveroo countries together into **one EMEA business**, with one team and a clear ambition: grow fast and build a business that stands on its own feet.

A growing share of that scaling comes from outside restaurants: grocers, retailers, pharmacies and other eComm players who want on-demand and same-day delivery for their own customers. Their needs can be very different from restaurants: bigger baskets, scheduled and batched deliveries, larger and heavier items, longer distances and more complex integrations. This brings us to you, our next **Manager, Strategy & Operations** for Grocery & Retail Drive.

You'll own this segment across EMEA, from strategy and planning to pricing, product requirements and performance. You'll work hand in hand with our regional commercial teams, who own the partner relationships, and with Product, Logistics, Finance and our Marketplace grocery & retail teams. You'll join the Drive EMEA Strategy & Operations team and report to the Director of Strategy & Operations, Drive EMEA.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Own the **Grocery & Retail strategy and annual plan** for Drive EMEA: where we play, which partners we go after, and the growth and profitability we commit to.
* Set the **commercial framework** for the segment, including pricing guidelines, deal economics and investment cases for our largest partnerships, together with the regional commercial leads.
* Act as the **voice of grocery and retail partners** towards Product and Logistics, turning commercial needs such as scheduled delivery or large and heavy items into sized, prioritized requirements.
* Run **performance management** for the segment: track growth, unit economics and service levels for our biggest partners, spot what's off and drive the fix with the teams involved.
* Shape how Drive works with our **Marketplace grocery & retail teams**, so partners get one joined-up offer from us.
* Turn wins into **playbooks** that country teams can reuse, from the first pitch to launch and scale-up.

**Our humble expectations**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, business development, commercial roles or management consulting, with a track record of owning outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Strong commercial and analytical skills: you can build a deal P&L or a segment plan from scratch, and defend it in front of a partner's leadership or our own.
* Proven ability to get things done across a matrix organization without direct authority, working with regional teams, Product, Logistics and Finance.
* You use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in your daily work, for example in analysis, planning and ways of working, and look for new ways to apply them to elevateyou - whilst maintaining strong judgement that comes from personal understanding complex systems
* Structured thinking and clear, concise communication in English, both written and spoken.
* Willingness to travel occasionally across our EMEA markets.

**Seen as a strong advantage:**

* Background in retail, grocery, e-commerce, logistics or on-demand delivery, either in-house or advising companies in these sectors.
* Experience with B2B platform or delivery-as-a-service businesses.

**Why you'll love it**
----------------------

* **Global and growing fast:** Be part of a fast-moving business at the moment it's being built, across two of Europe's best-known delivery brands
* **A segment to own:** Work with some of the biggest grocery and retail brands in Europe, and see what you write end up on the product roadmap
* **Ride of a lifetime:** Accelerate your career with direct access to DoorDash's global Drive experience and room to grow as the segment scales
* **Instant impact:** Take ownership and make a difference
* **Big hearts and small egos:** Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

**Next steps**
--------------

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply, make sure to add your CV in English and get the conversation going! We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

*Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at* *Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash* *.*

At Argos, we’re a digital-led UK retailer that keeps pushing boundaries to meet every generation with what they want, how and when they want it. As a market leader in general merchandise, serving millions of customers through our website, app, same-day delivery and Click & Collect services, we offer real opportunities to learn, grow and shape your career. The Crime and Security Manager is accountable for shaping and delivering the Argos crime, physical security and corporate security approach. The role helps create a safe and secure environment for Argos colleagues and customers, protects business assets and operations, and ensures emerging threats, serious incidents and security risks are identified and managed effectively.

Reporting to the Head of Central Operations, the role provides Argos-wide leadership and specialist expertise across stores, corporate locations, logistics interfaces, digital and customer operations. Own Argos preparedness for and response to serious crime and security incidents, ensuring effective governance, escalation, decision-making, communication and recovery arrangements aligned with relevant emergency-service protocols.

Use horizon scanning, intelligence, incident data and risk assessment to identify emerging threats, crime patterns and vulnerabilities, converting insight into timely operational and investment recommendations.

Provide senior specialist advice during events such as protest activity, civil disorder, terrorism-related threats, targeted risks and major operational incidents, coordinating with relevant Argos and Group teams and external agencies.

Build influential relationships with police, emergency services, the National Business Crime Centre, industry bodies, other retailers and specialist partners, representing Argos and using external insight to strengthen our approach.

Detailed knowledge of crime management, physical security and corporate security in a complex retail, customer-facing or multi-site environment.

Strong understanding of criminal and civil law relevant to crime and security, together with police, prosecution, court and evidence processes.

Detailed knowledge of incident and crisis management, threat assessment, emergency-service protocols and proportionate response to serious or emerging risks.

Strong supplier and commercial management capability, with experience of setting performance expectations, challenging delivery and securing value from third-party security services.

Ability to use intelligence, data, horizon scanning and risk assessment to prioritise resources and make clear, evidence-based recommendations.

Strong senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the credibility to communicate firmly and calmly in high-pressure situations and lead beyond formal reporting lines.

Sound judgement, integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information and making decisions that affect colleague and custom

Delivering essential infrastructure services for life, while being safety first, and client and customer centric in a friendly, fun and respectful environment where you are encouraged to thrive.

**Where will you be working?**

We help our clients safeguard the water supply, improve environmental performance and manage demand for future generations. We enhance and extend asset life, ensuring compliance with water quality and environmental standards. We’re problem solvers with over 140 years of combined experience in engineering and infrastructure.

This role will be within our water and wastewater Major Projects and capital project delivery team. Our teams deliver large-scale capital programmes aimed at keeping water infrastructure resilient for the long-term while protecting the environment.

Want to be a part of it?

**What will you be doing?**

As our Project Manager you'll play a key role our project delivery programme. You’ll coordinate seamlessly across design, planning, construction, commercial, permitting, traffic management, and commissioning. You'll own the end‑to‑end delivery of the trunk main package, ensuring performance against time, cost, quality, and safety targets. This includes establishing project governance, maintaining programme baselines, and driving risk and opportunity management. You’ll also lead CDM compliance and Principal Contractor duties, ensuring robust RAMS, permits, safe systems of work, and a strong safe‑by‑design approach.

You’ll act as the primary day‑to‑day interface with Thames Water, managing progress reporting, change control, assurance gates, and operational constraints. Your role covers environmental compliance, quality assurance, pressure testing, chlorination, as‑builts, and handover. You’ll manage key external stakeholders—including highways authorities, councils, landowners, businesses, and residents—while coordinating comms and consents for road closures, night works, and customer impact mitigation. You will also lead design development and approvals across MEICA and civils interfaces, ensuring constructability, phasing, utility surveys, and clash management.

You’ll produce and manage an integrated programme across design, permitting, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning—protecting the critical path, productivity, and delivery certainty. With ownership of budget, forecasting, change control, and subcontract performance, you will set clear expectations for the site team. Fostering a high‑performing culture built on behavioural safety, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

* Do you have a degree/HNC/HND or equivalent in Civil Engineering or Construction?
* Do you have Institute of Leadership and Management Level 5 or equivalent?
* Have you gained your NEBOSH National Certificate (General or Construction)?

* Do you have proven ability to deliver against operational targets?
* Do you hold a valid driving licence?
* Are you committed to delivering the highest health and safety standards?
* Do you have experience in an operational manager role?
* Have you gained experience of infrastructure delivery?
* Do you have experience in managing designers and subcontractors?
* Have you got SMSTS and Water hygiene?

**What’s in it for you?**

**We offer a range of benefits designed to support your life in and out of work, some of which include;**

* Matched or contributory pension scheme
* Online GP service, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year
* Employee assistance programme
* My Rewards portal, access to 1000’s of retail discounts
* Life assurance
* Cycle to work, salary finance and give as you earn schemes
* Enhanced maternity, paternity leave and adoption leave
* Reward and recognition scheme
* Recommend a friend – get rewarded for introducing people to us!

**In addition, this role offers;**

* Company car and fuel card with a range of EV and hybrid vehicles to choose from
* My Car Choice our salary sacrifice EV/ Hybrid car scheme
* Private health care - single cover
* Health Care Cash Plan, giving you the ability to claim back medical expenses for things like dental, eyecare and physiotherapy and much more!
* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
* Discretionary bonus scheme

**About us**

We want to be an employer of choice and a great place to work, attracting diverse and talented people, who join us and make a difference. We’re one of the Top 100 UK companies actively supporting and recruiting army veterans. Our ENABLE inclusion networks bring together people who have a shared passion, to help create an environment where everyone belongs.

Our values help to shape our culture and how we work with one another. We recruit with these values in mind, to ensure your aspirations, and ways of working, align with ours.

* We’re **responsible** and go further for our people, clients, communities and the planet
* We’re **open** and seek new and better ways of exceeding expectations
* We’re **together** and as one team; the whole is greater than the sum of the parts
* We’re **ambitious** and embrace opportunity, to lead essential infrastructure services for life

Whether you’re a trainee, apprentice or graduate, or progressing through your career, our people benefit from industry recognised programmes, training and development.

It’s an exceptional time to be a part of M Group.

### **About The Role**

We are looking for a technically skilled and versatile Senior Technical Business Analyst to join our team. This role is crucial in making regular maintenance & improvements, implementing new solutions and longer-term strategic enhancements to our Business Platform. The ideal candidate will be an expert in business application analysis and development, having worked with a wide range of enterprise-grade software platforms, including Salesforce.

You will work within the Business Platform Team and be responsible for eliciting requirements from various stakeholders and translating them into process maps, specifications, user stories and technical development tasks. This will be a demanding role which will require prioritising the backlog of work against business goals. You will need to influence senior business domain experts with support from colleagues within the Business Platform Team.

  

You will work closely with Business Platform Administrators and Developers to help understand business problems and translate them into viable solutions for the business. You will assist in User Acceptance Testing and release management of those solutions to ensure they are successfully deployed into production.

**Responsibilities**

* Accurately capture business needs ensuring processes are mapped out clearly for wider stakeholders
* Manage various backlog of requirements and needs and help map dependencies and understand competing priorities across the portfolio of work
* Use industry standard business analysis principles and tools to define requirements and processes that align with project goals
* Lead small-to-medium-sized projects in an internal consultancy capacity and supporting larger and more complex projects
* Own and manage stakeholder relationships
* Carry out research, UAT and identifying risks and mitigations
* Document detailed requirements, functional and non-functional, that can be validated with the relevant stakeholders
* Work independently where required
* Be an active part of the Business Platform Team to assist the team's successful delivery

* **Senior-level analytical practice:** Extensive progressive experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Product Owner delivering complex, enterprise-scale initiatives across the end-to-end software development life cycle (SDLC)
* **Requirements engineering:** Extensive experience facilitating requirements discovery workshops, root-cause analyses, and gap assessments; proven ability to translate ambiguous business objectives into structured functional, non-functional, and transition requirements

* **Stakeholder management & consensus building:** Strong executive presence, with demonstrated success negotiating scope trade-offs, resolving competing priorities, and communicating technical concepts clearly to senior stakeholders
* **CRM experience (****Preferred****):** Prior experience serving as a functional lead on enterprise-grade business platform transformation initiatives, ideally supporting sales, service, or customer operations workflows

**Technical skills**

* **Systems architecture & integrations:**Solid understanding of modern integration patterns, web services (REST/JSON), and middleware; hands-on experience authoring technical interface specifications and source-to-target data mapping documents
* **Process mapping & prototyping:** Advanced proficiency using visual modeling tools (e.g., Lucidchart, Miro, Visio) applying BPMN 2.0 and UML notations; experienced in building low-fidelity wireframes and user interaction flows (e.g., Figma, Balsamiq).
* **Agile project tooling:** High proficiency in configuring and maintaining Jira and Confluence (or Azure DevOps) for requirements traceability, sprint dashboards, and team documentation repositories.
* **Data analysis & modeling:** Strong proficiency in validating data integrity, and conducting exploratory analysis; firm grasp of data structures, normalisation, and Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERDs).

  + Familiarity with SOQL (Salesforce Object Query Language) and data utility tools (e.g., Salesforce Data Loader, Workbench, Salesforce Inspector) for data validation and schema inspection.
  + Ability to construct complex native Salesforce reports, dashboards, and custom report types.

--------------------------------------------------------

**Join us as an apprentice at the BBC to give yourself the opportunity to kick-start your career in a job you'll love. We’re committed to your skills and talent development. You’ll learn on-the-job, developing your knowledge and skills in an area that interests you, whilst working towards your apprenticeship qualification with one of our learning providers.**

**WHY JOIN THIS SCHEME?**
-------------------------

**Do you enjoy maths, spotting patterns in data, or working with Excel? Kick-start your career with the BBC as a Data Analyst Apprentice. You'll work on real projects, learn from industry experts, and help shape a data-driven future. Best of all, we'll teach you Python coding from scratch, giving you valuable skills for the future. If you're curious, enjoy teamwork, and love solving problems, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Want to find out more?** **Watch recordings from our webinar series on our** **Life at the BBC YouTube playlist** **to learn more about this scheme and other opportunities we offer, and hear from current apprentices about their experiences.**

**WHY JOIN THE TEAM?**
----------------------

**The News Data and Payments Team are a small team supporting our 24/7 global News operation.**

**We design, build and maintain data solutions in Excel, Smartsheet, Power Query, Power Automate and Power BI.**

**Areas we manage include mandatory training; hostile environments training around the world; taxi usage, make-up usage; workforce utilisation, and Press Card requests.**

**This is a very exciting time to join our team, we look forward to meeting you!**

----------------------------------------

**As a Data Analyst apprentice (DAA27), this is brilliant opportunity to learn, grow, and contribute – you will:**

* **Learn how data helps shape services, projects and performance across the organisation.**

* **Understand the importance of data privacy, ethics and responsible data use**

* **Enjoy working with data, numbers and excel spreadsheets, with an interest in maths and logical thinking.**
* **Have brilliant organisational skills and are great at problem-solving and negotiating**
* **Can manage multiple deadlines and demands on your time**
* **Have a calm and focused approach to changing circumstances**
* **Have a keen interest in the BBC and how people consume content, bursting with fresh ideas to introduce new perspectives**
* **Are an enthusiastic self-starter, flexible and adaptable to out-of-hours working**

**This scheme is aimed at** **non-graduates.** **If you have a degree and you’re interested in similar roles at the BBC, we recommend applying for jobs at the** **BBC careers site** **or having a look at our other apprenticeship schemes.**

**ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA**
------------------------

**To be eligible for an apprenticeship at the BBC, you must:**

* **Be 18 years old or over by the time the apprenticeship begins in September 2027.**
* **Have lived in the UK continuously for the last three years prior to the start of the apprenticeship.**
* **Be legally eligible to work full-time in the UK for the entire duration of the apprenticeship.**
* **Not currently be enrolled in another apprenticeship programme, whether with the BBC or another organisation.**

Are you passionate about making life science life changing and delivering impact for patients? We want to hear from you.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Research Operations Analyst to join LifeArc’s Technology team to work at the intersection of science and technology delivery to push the boundaries of our drug discovery through strategic use within our ELN/LIMS platform.

You will partner with our Therapeutic Discovery team to provide dedicated operational capability across our laboratory informatics platforms (Revvity Signal One). As our Research Operations Analyst, you will be working hand-in-hand with our Research Business Analyst and the scientists to provide day-to-day technical and scientific operational capability to translate strategy and user requirements into meaningful platform improvements. This role will promote consistent metadata attributes, improve user effectiveness and strengthen data quality and compliance.

* Drive adoption and provide operational support by coaching users, improving platform knowledge and helping teams apply agreed processes and business rules consistently
* Provide subject-matter expertise across the Revvity Signals One platform the creation and maintenance of material libraries and analysis workflows

* Experience of working in/with multi-functional teams
* Demonstrable experience in delivering innovative solutions to complex scientific problems, within a modern ELN/LIMS system
* Experience in providing first line support for ELM/LIMS systems
* Experience with driving user adoption, process transformation and minimising change resistance

**Desirable:**

* Relevant experience working in a similar research environment to ensure an understanding of team requirements and effective manifestation of workflows
* Experience of working in therapeutic discovery (small molecule and/or antibody drug discovery)
* Experience with mentoring and/or delivering training for a complex or niche system

**Education:**

* BSc in a Life Science or equivalent relevant experience

**Skills & abilities:**

* Excellent attention to detail with strong administrative and organisational skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex or technical information into clear accessible messages for a broad audience
* Self-motivated with the ability to learn quickly through experience and develop into a subject matter expert
* Ability to apply user-centred design principles and experimentation to develop impactful, evidence-based solutions
* Proven ability to build collaborative relationships in the workplace and work effectively across teams, functions and partnerships to achieve shared objectives.
* Ability to coach, influence and provide trusted advice to colleagues and stakeholders at all levels of the organisation

LifeArc is a not-for-profit life science organisation, leading the way for change in rare diseases in the UK and supporting promising initiatives in global health. jobs.title: Finance Data Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Description**

**The Vacancy**

We are seeking a Finance Data Analyst to join our growing Data & Digitalisation function, acting as the bridge between Finance, Data and Technology teams.

This role is ideal for a finance-qualified professional who understands how financial data flows through an organisation and can translate business requirements into trusted reporting and analytics solutions. You will work closely with senior finance stakeholders to define business rules, standardise metrics, improve data quality, and ensure reporting delivers meaningful business insight.

This is a highly visible position, collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation and helping establish a consistent, trusted view of financial performance across multiple businesses.

**Please note:** A recognised accountancy qualification (ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) and strong experience working with financial reporting and finance processes are essential requirements for this role.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Act as the finance domain expert for reporting, analytics and data initiatives.
* Define and document finance KPIs, business rules, calculations and reporting standards.
* Gather, analyse and translate business requirements into functional specifications for technical teams.
* Facilitate workshops with finance and business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Create and maintain mapping documents, data definitions, decision logs and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure financial data is accurately defined, reconciled and governed across systems and reports.
* Work closely with Data Engineers, BI Developers and business stakeholders to deliver reporting solutions.
* Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that support strategic and operational decision-making.
* Define and implement validation, reconciliation and audit controls to maintain data quality and reporting accuracy.
* Support the development of enterprise semantic models and reporting standards.
* Drive consistency and standardisation across finance reporting processes.
* Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Operations and Technology functions.

### **What We're Looking For**

**Essential Experience & Qualifications:**

* ACCA, CIMA or equivalent professional accountancy qualification.
* 4+ years' experience in a Finance Domain Analyst, Finance Business Analyst, Finance Data Analyst or similar finance-focused role.
* Strong understanding of finance processes, including: Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cost Centre Structures, Financial Reporting.
* Experience working with stakeholders at all levels, from operational teams through to Directors and senior business leaders.
* Strong requirements gathering, process analysis and workshop facilitation skills.

jobs.description:
About the Role

  

Join the Export Local Markets & Travel Retail EMEA team as a Merchandising Project Manager on a permanent contract. You will be responsible for shaping and leading the end-to-end merchandising strategy for campaigns across more than 30 Local Markets and Travel Retail EMEA.

  
  

Reporting to the Category, Client Experience & Merchandising Manager, you will work closely with Category, Marketing, Sales, and Forecasting teams to ensure consistent, impactful, and market-relevant campaign deployments. The position is based in Paris. The application period will remain open for 2 weeks until 17 november 2026.

  
  

What impact you can create at Chanel

  

* Oversee the end-to-end merchandising strategy for campaigns, from budget development and forecasting including the delivery of non-catalogued campaign assets and define implementation guidelines to ensure consistent, high-quality execution across all points of sale.
  

  

* Co-develop the permanent assortment strategy with the Product Manager for local markets and EMEA Travel Retail, optimising the offer by point of sale according to its potential, format, available space, channel-specific requirements and business priorities.
  

  

* Define scalable, channel-specific merchandising solutions that address the diverse needs of local markets as well as the specific constraints of the Travel Retail channel.
  

  

* Support markets and partners throughout campaign deployment, ensuring clear communication, brand excellence and consistent implementation across all points of sale.
  

  

* Design and deliver campaign-focused training sessions and workshops, organise and facilitate seminars, and provide operational support to equip market and field teams with the merchandising skills, tools and best practices required to ensure consistent execution.
  

  

You are energised by

  

* The opportunity to shape how campaigns come to life across two complementary and highly diverse distribution environments, by developing strategies tailored to the specificities of Local Markets and Travel Retail EMEA.
  

  

* Becoming a key contributor in designing and deploying campaigns that combine the high standards of the Brand with the agility required to address the needs of each market and channel.
  

  

* Directly strengthening Brand visibility and desirability across the entire point-of-sale network.
  

  

* Playing a central coordination role between cross-functional teams and markets to continuously elevate executional excellence across the network.
  

  

What you will bring

  

* A Master’s degree or Business School background, with 3 to 5 years of experience in merchandising, operational marketing, campaign management, or a related field.
  

  

* Strong strategic thinking and project management skills, with the ability to turn campaign ambition into concrete retail execution.
  

  

* The ability to navigate complex, multicultural, and multi-channel environments, adapting solutions without compromising Brand standards.
  

  

* Fluent in French and English, you are comfortable communicating, engaging stakeholders, and building strong relationships in an international environment.
  

  

* Previous experience with the IWD merchandising software would be appreciated.
  

  

What Chanel can offer you

  

* The opportunity to operate within a uniquely rich and diverse distribution network: more than 30 Local Markets with varying levels of maturity, consumer profiles, and retail environments, alongside the distinctive Travel Retail ecosystem across airports in Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.
  

  

* The chance to shape a high-impact strategy, directly influencing Brand visibility, point-of-sale executional excellence, and commercial performance across both channels.
  

  

* The opportunity to strengthen your business and strategic perspective through the management of merchandising budgets and investment trade-offs across markets with diverse potential, challenges, and constraints.
  

  

* A rewarding management experience, supporting the development and autonomy of an apprentice.
  

  

* Guide markets and partners throughout campaign execution, ensuring clarity, Brand excellence, and consistent implementation across points of sale.
  

  

*At CHANEL, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.*

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Category, Expérience Client & Merchandising, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Category, Marketing, Sales et Forecasting afin de garantir des déploiements cohérents, impactants et adaptés aux spécificités de chaque marché et canal. Le poste est basé à Paris. La période de candidature restera ouverte pendant deux semaines, jusqu’au 17 novembre 2026.

* Superviser la stratégie merchandising de bout en bout pour les campagnes, depuis l’élaboration des budgets et des prévisions jusqu’à la livraison des supports de campagne hors catalogue, et définir les directives de mise en œuvre afin de garantir une exécution cohérente et de haute qualité sur l’ensemble des points de vente.
  

  

* Co-construire avec le Product Manager la stratégie d’assortiment permanent pour les marchés locau

**Réf. de l'offre :** AXAFR\_37499 **Localisation :** PUTEAUX - 92 **Contrat :** CDI Dispositifs handicap **Société :** AXA France Télétravail (selon profil poste) **Expérience :** Expérimentés **Salaire :** Selon profil et expérience

**VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS**
------------------------------

AXA is expanding its Employee Benefits activities internationally, supported by AXA EB Partners, a specialized Insurtech bringing together Employee Benefits expertise, digital delivery, data capabilities and integration excellence.

Founded in 2015, EB Partners brings together more than 75 internal and external team members across France, Japan and Vietnam. Its solutions currently support clients in 18 countries across Employee Benefits and Health.

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to join the EB Partners Service Excellence team and lead international initiatives around our Service Platform, a modular digital ecosystem designed for employees, employers, distributors and administrators.

You will work at the intersection of business, customer experience and technology, coordinating international stakeholders and helping local markets deliver engaging, scalable and locally relevant digital experiences. Projects span markets including France, Spain, Germany, Japan, Hong Kong and the Philippines, with opportunities to support further international expansion.

  

As Senior Project Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of Service Platform implementations and enhancements, from initial discovery and co-design through configuration, integration, UAT, deployment, adoption and post-go-live stabilization.You will:

  

* Lead international implementations of Employee, Employer, Distributor and Admin portals, coordinating local AXA teams and EB Partners specialists.
* Translate business and user needs into clear customer journeys, requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria and delivery roadmaps.
* Manage project scope, planning, milestones, dependencies, risks, governance and stakeholder communication.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams covering UX/UI, low-code/no-code configuration, development and systems integration.
* Promote a modular, reusable approach, leveraging existing global capabilities while adapting solutions to local business, regulatory and operational requirements.
* Coordinate integration requirements including authentication and SSO, APIs, data exchanges, document services, notifications, e-signature, payment and third-party services where applicable.
* Drive UAT, release readiness, training, deployment, adoption and post-launch support.
* Help shape healthcare and wellbeing service ecosystems by coordinating insurers, healthcare or wellbeing providers and other partners.
* Identify and assess opportunities for AI-enabled services, including AI chatbots and AI agents, and translate relevant use cases into pragmatic roadmaps considering business value, user experience, data readiness, integration, security, privacy and responsible AI.
* Facilitate workshops, steering committees and working groups, ensuring clear decisions, ownership and follow-up.
* Support local teams in building sustainable ownership of the platform and its configurable capabilities.

**VOTRE PROFIL**
----------------

You have at least 5 years of professional experience, with meaningful responsibility for digital portal, self-service, low-code/no-code or technology-enabled insurance projects. More than formal programme-management credentials, we value your ability to independently drive stakeholders, adoption and delivery outcomes.

  

You bring:

  

* Proven experience delivering customer, partner, employee or comparable B2B/B2C digital portals, from discovery through production rollout and adoption.
* Strong project management fundamentals across planning, governance, scope, risks, dependencies, UAT, release management and stakeholder decision-making.
* A good understanding of digital delivery topics such as UX/UI, CMS or low-code/no-code platforms, authentication/SSO, APIs and data interfaces.
* The ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements and delivery decisions for multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience working in agile or hybrid environments and proficiency with Jira and Confluence.
* Experience working in an international, matrixed environment with distributed teams.
* Fluent written and spoken English. Business-level French is preferred for French projects.
* Knowledge of Employee Benefits or insurance across Health, Protection or Pension is a strong advantage, as is familiarity with healthcare and wellbeing ecosystems.
* Previous IT development experience is a plus

**What will help you succeed**

  

You are comfortable taking ownership and moving projects forward without waiting for detailed direction. You know how to bring together stakeholders with different priorities, cultures and ways of working, and turn complexity into clear decisions and actions.

You combine a pragmatic, analytical mindset with strong communication skills. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, negotiating priorities and escalating risks early with practical options.

You are also curious about how emerging technologies, particularly generative AI, AI chatbots and AI agents, can improve digital services while meeting security, privacy, operational and responsible-AI requirements.

  

**The environment you will join**

  

EB Partners’ Service Platform combines reusable portal components with a low-code/no-code Builder platform to accelerate time to market while enabling local teams to adapt content and configurations.

The wider platform supports Employee Benefits journeys including enrolment, benefits and services, documents, claims, reporting and user administration, alongside capabilities such as digital claims management, enrolment automation and premium billing.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Product Data Operations (Reality Labs)
jobs.description:
Meta is hiring a Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager to run multilingual data collection (DC) for our language expansion work. Reality Labs builds the next generation of computing across Meta's mixed reality, virtual reality, and wearables products. As we bring AI experiences to more languages and regions, the quality, coverage, and speed of our multilingual data shape how well our models understand and respond to people around the world.In this role, you'll take model and product requirements from intake through delivery. For each request, you'll pick the collection model that fits best: in-house collection, scaled vendor collection, or a mix of both. You'll also build DC practices that can scale and repeat across languages and locales. You'll work across functions with research, engineering, product, quality, legal/privacy, and vendor partners. You'll define and enforce quality standards for data deliverables in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift frequently.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Product Data Operations (Reality Labs) Responsibilities:**

* Own the full lifecycle of language expansion data collection programs, from requirements intake and scoping through collection, quality assurance, and dataset delivery
* Turn model, evaluation, and product requirements into clear collection specs: language and locale coverage, speaker and participant criteria, volume targets, timelines, and acceptance criteria
* Choose the right DC model for each need (in-house, scaled vendor, or hybrid) based on quality, speed, cost, coverage, and risk, and explain the tradeoffs to stakeholders
* Build repeatable DC playbooks, SOPs, templates, and intake standards so that new languages and locales can launch quickly and consistently
* Work closely with research scientists, engineers, TPMs, product, linguists, quality, and privacy partners to align on priorities, dependencies, and success measures
* Develop systems that operationalize data to track throughput, cost, and quality trends. Build dashboards and leadership-facing reporting that drive decisions
* Prioritize competing requests based on impact, urgency, and stakeholder needs. Iterate on plans as model training schedules change, escalate risks early, and ensure that budget targets are met

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed before joining Meta

* Experience in communicating with and influencing multiple cross-functional stakeholders and leaders
* Experience defining and maintaining quality standards and acceptance criteria for data deliverables
* Analytical experience using data to spot trends, diagnose operational issues, and influence program direction
* Experience prioritizing competing workstreams based on impact and deadlines in fast-moving, agile environments with changing priorities
* Experience breaking ambiguous problems into component parts to develop solutions
* In-person presence at least 3 days per week, with occasional travel required

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in owning program budgets, cost forecasting, or per-unit cost tracking

* Proficiency in one or more languages besides English, as the role supports multilingual data collection programs across multiple regions and locales
* Track record of building scalable, repeatable operating models or playbooks for a service function
* Experience designing hybrid in-house and vendor sourcing strategies, including cost/quality trade-off analysis
* Experience with participant recruitment, screening criteria, informed consent, and data governance for human-subject data across regions
* Experience with multilingual, speech, text, or conversational AI data, including localization or language expansion programs
* Experience building or deploying automation or AI solutions in production workflows
* Experience in AR/VR, wearables, consumer electronics or AI products

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

**ReadyOn.AI** is an AI-native Labor Operating System that is redefining how the world’s largest enterprises manage frontline labor. Born out of a Stanford AI Lab, the company applies advanced AI and market-design principles to one of the hardest optimization problems on earth: matching the world’s 2.7 billion frontline workers to the right shifts, in real time.

Frontline workers now expect the same flexibility and autonomy that gig platforms provide, while large employers face relentless pressure to meet aggressive labor-cost targets. ReadyOn bridges that divide with a system of action that predicts workforce demand, dynamically matches it to an employer’s supply of employees, and automates the thousands of staffing decisions made daily across complex, multi-site operations.

The platform is already proven at global scale, powering labor operations for several of the world’s largest enterprises. Landmark customers include a F250 food-service enterprise (300K employees across 16 countries; $7B+ annual labor spend, a F500 hotel group (250K+ employees; $5B+ annual labor spend), a F250 entertainment operator (75K employees; $4B+ labor spend). Across these deployments, ReadyOn has proven that scheduling was never the real problem—it was a symptom. The true challenge is how to match people and work dynamically at scale. ReadyOn solves this problem with an AI system of action that transforms labor from a fixed cost into a strategic advantage, reshaping how enterprises think about workforce design altogether.

Headquartered in San Francisco with 80 employees, ReadyOn grew 8x year-over-year revenue growth in 2025, driven by multiple seven-figure Fortune 250 enterprise deployments and a rapidly expanding pipeline.

**Transform How Frontline Work Runs**

Enterprises struggle to manage hundreds of millions of dollars in frontline labor spend due to decades-old software and manual processes, creating massive, avoidable costs. Frontline labor often represents 40% of the P&L, yet the systems managing this $3 trillion market were built for static schedules and limited flexibility.

ReadyOn was founded to reject that paradigm. Staffing is not a scheduling problem; it is a real-time supply–demand orchestration problem. ReadyOn is an AI-native labor operating system, built from the ground up for AI agents to perform real-time labor optimization - much like ridesharing platforms that match drivers and riders in real time, but applied to frontline labor instead of fixed, one-size-fits-all schedules.

**Who’s Building It**

AI is not a bolt-on feature in our platform. Every decision, from demand forecasting to shift assignment, flows through an adaptive, autonomous decision layer that learns from operational data and continuously optimizes for cost, compliance, and worker satisfaction. Behind that system is a founding team of experts in labor markets, enterprise software, and AI-enabled platforms:

**Reza** **– Engineering leader who scaled enterprise systems at Google, Yahoo, and AT&T**

**Dominic** **– Operator who optimized labor-intensive operations in 21 countries**

**Mohammad** **– Stanford professor and leading expert in algorithmic market design**

ReadyOn has already proven product–market fit with multiple multi-million-dollar customers, consistent expansion within existing accounts, and measurable ROI that moves stock prices.

**Deployment Strategist Role**

Joining the Enterprise Partnerships team, the Deployment Strategist works across multiple customer deployments and alongside our Engagement Managers to turn complex labor environments into working ReadyOn deployments. You will contribute directly to live Fortune 500 implementations: building configurations, running data analyses, supporting training delivery, and joining customer engagements.

You will also build the structured product intelligence that helps Engineering and Product understand what is happening in the field. The best people in this role become the team’s institutional memory, and the role grows from deployment execution into product synthesis, analytical infrastructure, and solutions work. Strong performers move into Engagement Management, Solutions Engineering, or Product roles.

**Ideal Candidates:**

* **Learn by Doing:** You get up to speed quickly in unfamiliar tools, data, and operating environments, and you are comfortable contributing to live Fortune 500 deployments from day one.
* **Turn Data into Decisions:** You break down ambiguous operational questions, work directly with messy data, and move quickly from analysis to a clear recommendation.

* **Build for Reuse:** You look for the template, script, or playbook that makes the next deployment faster than the last, and you build it.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager III, Network Infrastructure Planning, Google Cloud
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with supply or demand planning (e.g., demand forecasting, inventory management, resource allocation, etc.).
* Experience working with data analytics tools and reporting platforms.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience with supply/demand planning, material planning, data center infrastructure, or capital investment decision making.
* Experience in managing technical programs with hardware teams.
* Ability to take accountability and ownership for end-to-end project lifecycle.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As part of the Network Planning team, you will be responsible for enabling various data center networking deployments by working with cross functional teams to develop end to end strategies that connect our demand, supply, inventory, data center labor and deployment planning. Your role will directly enable improving effectiveness of network planning team and overall network domain.  
  
This role requires an individual to leverage strategic and end to end thinking. Successful individuals in this role have strong planning backgrounds with an engineering mindset, while being expert communicators and leaders. They are comfortable with ambiguity and complexity, yet strive to increase maturity in processes. They also have the ability to handle multiple programs at the same time while being highly customer focused.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Identify changes introduced by large scale business initiatives, drive business requirements and lead development/implementation with engineering teams to successfully land the programs.
* Partner with cross functional teams in deployments, supply chain planning, operations and engineering to identify, develop and lead large scale programs that improve our deployment velocity, inventory efficiency and supply resiliency.
* Develop and lead new forums, reports with key stakeholders and leaders to identify and flag risks, delivery challenges that need escalation, and highlight achievement of key milestones throughout the planning and execution cycles.
* Define, track and report on key performance metrics and raise issues proactively to ensure on-time follow-through.
* Define continuous improvement areas based upon metrics and work with engineering/systems team to establish program roadmaps to deliver the improvements.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Capital Markets Strategy and Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About GoodLeap:

GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018.

GoodLeap is also proud to support our award-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.

#### **Position Summary:**

The Capital Markets Strategy & Operations Analyst supports the funding and sale of GoodLeap’s consumer finance loans by operationalizing revolving credit facilities, whole loan purchase agreements, and asset-backed securitizations. The Analyst manages day-to-day loan funding and sales activity, supports and maintains GoodLeap’s investor relationships, and works directly with lenders, capital partners, and their third-party vendors. Reporting to the Manager of Capital Markets Strategy & Operations, the Analyst collaborates closely with Capital Markets, Legal, Servicing, Underwriting, Product, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, and Business Development.

### **Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Initiates whole loan sales by determining loan pool eligibility against investor criteria, then preparing and delivering loan schedules, loan agreements, and underwriting documentation to investors.
* Serves as a point of contact for investors and their vendors during loan reviews, partnering with Product, Engineering, Servicing, and Underwriting to answer questions, evaluate exceptions, and resolve them.
* Manages day-to-day activity on GoodLeap’s revolving warehouse credit facilities, including borrowing base calculations, funding requests, and covenant compliance monitoring.
* Develops and maintains Excel-based models, including the Sales Engine and Funding Engine, and drives automation by identifying process improvements, defining requirements, and helping build and maintain capital markets software solutions.
* Analyzes alternatives, makes recommendations to management, and implements consumer finance funding and sales strategies.
* Leads new investor onboarding and prepares and analyzes ongoing investor and management reporting, flagging trends and issues for leadership.

### **Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:**

The Analyst brings at least two years of experience in financial modeling and analysis, and at least two years in capital markets, treasury, or finance. They have advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Databricks, and AI tools (e.g., Claude), with the technical ability to manipulate and analyze large datasets and apply statistical methods to them. They communicate findings clearly, in writing and verbally, to management, investors, and other external parties. They have a solid grasp of capital markets, finance, accounting, and business operations concepts, and ideally bring experience in financial services, consumer finance, fintech, or renewable energy finance. They work well across Capital Markets, Legal, Servicing, Underwriting, Product, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, and Business Development, and represent GoodLeap professionally while building lasting relationships with funding and capital partners. Above all, they are a curious, tenacious problem solver and a strong team player.

Compensation: $95,000-$105,000 plus bonus

This job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and other skills required for the position. The Company reserves the right at any time with or without notice to alter or change job responsibilities, reassign or transfer job position or assign additional job responsibilities, subject to applicable law. The Company shall provide reasonable accommodations of known disabilities to enable a qualified applicant or employee to apply for employment, perform the essential functions of the job, or enjoy the benefits and privileges of employment as required by the law.

-------------------

A successful customer relationship starts with a strong implementation. At KPA, our Client Implementation Managers play a key role in making that happen, helping new customers get up and running with the tools they need to manage compliance, reduce risk, and operate more effectively.

We're looking for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, solving problems, and bringing structure to complex projects. You'll own the implementation process from initial planning and configuration through training and launch, helping customers navigate challenges and get the most out of KPA's solutions.

This role combines project management, technical problem-solving, and customer relationship management. You'll work closely with customers and internal teams to keep implementations moving forward, resolve roadblocks, and create a positive experience that sets the foundation for long-term success.

* **Set customers up for long-term success.** Ensure implementations are completed successfully and customers experience a smooth transition to their ongoing Client Success team.

### **What You'll Bring:**

* At least 2 years of experience in a customer-facing role, ideally involving customer onboarding, implementation, project coordination, or technical support.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and keep projects moving forward.

* Experience working with Salesforce.

* You'll be successful when you're able to independently manage implementations, build trust with customers, anticipate challenges before they become larger problems, and work effectively across teams to deliver a smooth onboarding experience.
* Above all, you'll bring a combination of accountability, curiosity, and a customer-first mindset to your work, helping KPA deliver on its commitment to making compliance simpler and more effective.

### **Compensation:**

* Base salary of 65-75k commensurate with experience
* Annual bonus up to 7.5%

Physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Visual Recognition - Constantly
* Stationary sitting or standing position - Constantly
* Working at a computer typing and view a screen - Constantly
* Speaking, Hearing, and Listening - Often

**Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager – Energy Star Team**

**Help us certify high-performance buildings that cut energy use and carbon emissions.**

Southern Energy Management is a certified B Corporation on a mission to improve the way people make and use energy. Since 2001, we've been proving that businesses can be a force for good—and we've been recognized as an INC Best Place to Work for making that journey rewarding for our team.

We're looking for a building performance professional to join our Multifamily and Commercial Energy Services Team as either a **Program Manager** or **Assistant Program Manager**. Whether you're a seasoned rater ready to lead projects or an emerging professional with field testing experience ready to level up, there's a place for you here.

**Location:** Remote (Ideally NC, SC, VA)

**Employment Type:** Full-time, salaried, exempt

**What You'll Do**

You'll own Energy Star & Earthcraft certification projects from enrollment to final certification—guiding multifamily developers and builders through the technical requirements while ensuring buildings perform as designed. Your energy modeling reviews, field verifications, and technical problem-solving directly determine whether buildings earn the Energy Star or Earthcraft labels.

**Your day-to-day:**

* Manage Energy Star Multifamily New Construction and Earthcraft certification projects from design through completion
* Review and validate residential energy models to ensure accuracy and program compliance
* Conduct field inspections (up to 20% of your time) and performance testing at construction sites
* Be the technical expert your project teams rely on—developers, architects, builders, and engineers
* Troubleshoot compliance issues and provide creative solutions to meet certification targets
* Coordinate with field technicians on inspection scheduling and corrective work
* Track project milestones, invoices, and deliver proactive client updates
* Collaborate with a supportive team that values technical excellence and continuous learning

**We're Hiring Two Levels**

**Program Manager** (63,000–78,000)

* RESNET, Energy Star credentials (SFNH or MFNC) & Earthcraft TA strongly preferred
* Experience with LEED, Fitwel, Green Globes and Life Cycle Analysis is also a great asset
* 3–5 years in field verification, energy rating, or green building certification
* Strong working knowledge of residential energy modeling (ekotrope, REM/Rate, or similar)
* Bachelor's degree in building science, construction, sustainability, architecture, or related field
* Demonstrated ability to review energy models and catch discrepancies

**Assistant Program Manager** (48,000–63,000)

* 1–3 years in field testing, green building programs, or energy rating
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
* Experience with blower door testing, duct testing, or other diagnostic equipment preferred
* Familiarity with energy modeling software helpful (we'll train you)
* RESNET or other green building credentials a plus—we'll support your professional development

**Both roles require:**

* Technical understanding of building science fundamentals and HVAC systems
* Strong communication skills for explaining complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
* Excellent organization and attention to detail—accuracy matters in energy ratings
* Comfort with Google Workspace and Asana, and ability to learn energy modeling software
* Willingness to travel occasionally for field inspections across NC, SC, and VA

**About You**

You're detail-oriented and technically curious. You get excited about building performance data and love solving the puzzle of how to make buildings more efficient. You're an "ideal team player"—humble, hungry, and smart (in the emotional intelligence sense). You want your work to have measurable environmental impact. You’re passionate about sustainability.

**Why Join Us?**

**Mission that matters.** Energy Star and Earthcraft buildings use significantly less energy, reducing carbon emissions and utility costs for residents.

**Growth-focused culture.** We invest in a Team Member’s credentials, relevant training, and career development. The majority of our Guidance Team (Senior Management Team) started in entry level roles.

**Technical community.** You'll work alongside experienced raters, modelers, and building science professionals who love geeking out about building science.

**Real benefits.** Comprehensive health insurance, 401(k) matching, progressive PTO, professional development budget (including certification costs), and more.

**Flexibility.** Work remotely from North Carolina, South Carolina, or Virginia.

**Ready to Apply?**

We're reviewing applications and scheduling interviews as they come in, so if this role excites you, don't wait. The sooner you apply, the sooner we can start a conversation.

SEM values diversity and inclusion. We strongly encourage applications from women, BIPOC, and LGBTQIA+ candidates. We're committed to bringing historically disenfranchised voices to the forefront of climate and energy justice work.

Apply today and help us lead the change.

**About Quiktrak**  
Quiktrak provides floor plan audit and asset-verification services for banks, captive finance companies, independent lenders, and dealer networks across industries such as powersports, marine, recreational vehicles, transportation, and construction equipment.

Our Checks platform is changing how client audit programs are configured, implemented, validated, and supported. The Business Analyst works at the intersection of client needs, operational realities, system behavior, and product decisions.

Quiktrak is seeking a Business Analyst to turn business, client, and operational needs into clear configuration decisions, testable system requirements, and reliable solutions in Checks and related Quiktrak systems.

You must be able to schedule work and meetings across Quiktrak's national business window, generally between 6:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time (9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Eastern Time), depending on team and client needs. You will own the Validation Menu, non-workflow requirements and configuration analysis, acceptance criteria, integrated validation, and the Business Analyst workstream.

* Identify conflicting inputs, downstream effects, risks, and missing decisions before configuration or development begins.
