**About Wolf Electric Supply Company**

Wolf Electric Supply Company specializes in electrical wholesale distribution, providing electrical materials, equipment, and related products to contractors and businesses involved in commercial and industrial construction. Its product offerings include lighting fixtures, electrical wire, conduit, switchgear, fittings, and other essential electrical supplies used in construction and infrastructure projects.

The company's operations depend on efficient inventory management, accurate purchasing records, reliable supplier relationships, and organized distribution processes to support customer orders and construction project requirements.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Electrical Distribution Operations Analyst to help monitor, evaluate, and improve operational activities across inventory management, purchasing, warehouse operations, order fulfilment, and product distribution. This position is ideal for an analytical professional with experience in operations reporting, inventory analysis, supply chain coordination, business data analysis, or distribution operations who wants to build a career in the electrical wholesale distribution industry.

**Job Summary**

Wolf Electric Supply Company is seeking an Electrical Distribution Operations Analyst who will support the collection, analysis, monitoring, and reporting of operational data related to electrical product inventory, purchasing activities, supplier performance, warehouse operations, customer orders, and distribution processes.

Working with sales, purchasing, warehouse, inventory management, logistics, and accounting teams, the analyst will help ensure that operational information is accurate, accessible, and useful for evaluating business performance and identifying opportunities for improvement.

The position will involve reviewing inventory movement, tracking order fulfilment, monitoring product availability, preparing operational reports, and identifying inefficiencies that may affect purchasing decisions, material availability, and customer delivery schedules.

This is an entry-level opportunity for someone with strong analytical and organizational skills who understands the importance of accurate operational data and efficient distribution processes. Previous experience in electrical distribution or construction supplies is helpful but not required.

**Why Join Our Team?**

* Join Wolf Electric Supply Company and build your career in the electrical wholesale distribution and construction supply industry while contributing to efficient business operations and distribution performance. You'll gain hands-on experience analysing inventory records, purchasing activities, warehouse operations, supplier performance, and customer order fulfilment while developing valuable skills in operational reporting, data analysis, inventory management, and process improvement.
* Work alongside sales, purchasing, warehouse, logistics, and operations teams to identify inefficiencies, improve material availability, and support reliable product distribution. Gain practical knowledge of electrical supply operations, contractor purchasing requirements, and the movement of electrical materials from suppliers to customers.
* With opportunities to expand your industry knowledge, strengthen your analytical abilities, and take on greater responsibilities, this role offers a solid foundation for long-term career growth in operations analysis, inventory management, supply chain operations, and distribution management.

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor and analyse operational data related to electrical product inventory, purchasing activities, warehouse operations, customer orders, and distribution performance.
* Maintain and review inventory records covering electrical wire, cables, conduit, lighting fixtures, switchgear, fittings, and other electrical distribution products.
* Analyse stock movement, inventory turnover, product availability, and replenishment activity to help identify potential shortages, excess inventory, and purchasing requirements.
* Review purchase orders, sales orders, supplier confirmations, and delivery records to ensure operational information is accurate and complete.
* Track order fulfilment activities and evaluate the status of customer orders, pending materials, backorders, and outstanding deliveries.
* Prepare routine operational reports and spreadsheets covering inventory levels, purchasing activity, supplier lead times, warehouse performance, order processing, and distribution efficiency.
* Identify discrepancies between inventory records, warehouse counts, purchase orders, and sales transactions; investigate and coordinate corrections with the appropriate departments.

new_jobs.title: Customer Deployment Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Endra**

Every building is designed twice. The architect shapes what you see. MEP engineers design everything that makes it work: the power, air and water behind every hospital, data centre and home. It's a $150 billion industry still run on manual work and decades-old tools, and it's running out of engineers just as the world needs more buildings than ever.

We're building the platform that changes that. Endra's takes over the repetitive work so engineers can do what they're trained for: judgment and design. Some of the world's most respected engineering firms, including AtkinsRéalis, Ramboll, Buro Happold, Hoare Lea, Tetra Tech, AFRY and Rejlers, already build with us.

Since 2024, we've raised $75 million from Andreessen Horowitz, Notion Capital and Norrsken VC, and grown into a team across Stockholm, Zurich, London, New York and San Francisco. We're early, moving fast and setting out to change how the world's buildings get designed.

We're looking for people who care deeply about their craft, take ownership of complex problems, push us to think bigger, and are driven to create something with lasting impact.

**About the role**

For us, a signed contract is the starting line. The moment a customer signs, Customer Deployment takes over, and our job is to make Endra the way their engineers actually work as soon as possible.

As Customer Deployment Manager, you'll own that journey for some of our most important customers: large engineering consultancies with many offices, hundreds of engineers, and a long list of stakeholders who all need to say yes. You'll be the project lead for each rollout. You set up the structure, drive adoption, clear the roadblocks, and make the value impossible to miss.

You'll work hand in hand with our product specialists who are MEP engineers: they bring the MEP depth, you bring the structure and the commercial lens. Together you'll help engineers who have worked the same way for decades adopt a new one.

**What you'll do**.

* **Own onboarding and rollout.** Lead on-site and remote onboarding with our product specialists so MEP engineers get up and running fast and deliver real results using Endra on their very first project. You own the plan and the milestones, and you keep every stakeholder moving.
* **Work every stakeholder.** Cover everyone from the CEO and heads of discipline to BIM managers, IT and the engineers on the project. Keep them involved at the right moments, and turn early users into champions who train their colleagues.
* **Measure and report the wins.** Agree on success criteria with each customer, track adoption and account health, and act on risk early. Turn the results into clear wins for their leadership and for Endra.
* **Clear the roadblocks.** Spot what's stalling early, whether it's technical, organizational, or a skeptical team. Bring in the right people and see it through.
* **Find the next opportunity.** Uncover new teams, offices and use cases, and support account managers with further growing the customer accounts.
* **Shape the product.** Bring structured insight from the field to product and engineering, so what we build next is what customers need.
* **Build the playbook.** Our deployment function is young. You'll define how Endra rolls out, measures and reports, and set the standard the team scales on.

**Who you are**

* You've run or played a key role in enterprise software rollouts, with 3–5 years of client-facing experience in customer success, implementation or management consulting, ideally in a complex, expert-driven industry.
* You've driven change management before and know that getting a large organization onto new technology is as much about people as about software.
* You're structured and organized, and you stay calm when there are many moving parts.
* You take ownership, and your track record shows it in results delivered and responsibilities that grew.
* You have commercial instinct. You know adoption drives renewal and expansion, and you think about the customer's business case, not only usage numbers.
* You're an excellent communicator, in writing and in the room, and a team player who makes the people around you better.
* You’re comfortable building as you go, improving a playbook rather than just following it.

**How we think and work**

* Less is more: We simplify and ship smaller, fast.
* Build the right things: We listen carefully and build what users actually need.
* Velocity & Quality: We build things that last, but we don’t perfect them forever.
* Trust & Collaboration: Strong opinions, loosely held.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and equity.
* Employee-friendly equity terms.
* Private health insurance.
* Regular team events and off-sites.
* An inspiring, ambitious, and global work environment.

**Ready to move the needle?**

Do you feel this is your opportunity to do your most meaningful work and reshape an entire industry? Let's talk!

Compensation Range: $140K - $190K

Description Senior Associate, Project Manager - Commercial Digital Banking Well Managed Team

**About the Role:**
  
As the Sr. Project Manager on Digital Banking’s Well Managed Team, you will work directly with leaders in product, tech, design, and the enterprise to develop, deliver, and sustain our digital banking well-managed agenda. You will leverage your project, process, and risk management skills to ensure we maintain compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements. The role will work directly with product managers, software engineers, risk and compliance partners along with data teams to develop and monitor a well-managed operation.

  
  

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

  
  

**On any given day you will be:**

* Overseeing the project management lifecycle for control-related initiatives, ensuring timely execution, clear communication, and adherence to quality standards.
* Solving complex problems and consulting on new capabilities by leveraging your subject matter expertise.
* Building, enhancing, and managing processes and controls to ensure the day-to-day delivery of key functions.
* Driving the implementation of preventive controls to minimize risk events and improve operational efficiency.
* Partnering with Risk Management to identify, assess, and mitigate potential risks involving data management and data movement systems.
* Collaborating with Product Management and Technology teams to integrate effective controls into the design and development of new and existing features.
* Influencing management through the effective presentation of insights and recommendations for improvement.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**

* **Monitoring and Metrics for digital platform** releases as well as BAU to all LOB heads and other stakeholders
  + **Performance Monitoring**: Contribute to monitoring the performance of the digital banking platforms, services, and processes against framework guidelines and established metrics.
  + **Performance Metrics**: Establish key technical, client, and associate metrics reviewed on a set cadence to ensure the platform is operating optimally. Where metrics indicate an opportunity for improvement or escalation, manage to closure.
  + **Monthly Business Review (MBR)**: Author and coordinate monthly development and submission of Digital Banking Team’s MBR for stakeholders
  + **Associate and client experience feedback**: Co-lead data collection, LT reporting, and initiative prioritization for our digital platforms
* **Streamlined management and oversight** for compliance, process, risk and regulatory reporting impacting the program - controls, L1 - L4 process maps, risk findings, etc.
  + **Process Optimization**: Identify opportunities for process improvement within the framework, contributing to the development and implementation of optimized workflows for areas such as platform management and maintenance, fraud, business operations, and cyber/security operations.
  + **Documentation and Standards**: Assist in the creation and maintenance of documentation, policies, and standards related to the digital banking platforms (e.g., IT governance, data management, project management, release management).
  + **Compliance and Risk Support**: Support efforts related to compliance management, risk management, regulatory agencies, and internal controls.
* **Vendor Management Support**: Assist in supporting vendor performance and portfolio management activities as they relate to the overall framework.
* **Operational Monitoring & Control Testing**: Execute monitoring of control reporting and investigations to rule-out issues, including direct outreach to partners and associates and conducting root cause research for system/process breakdowns.
  + These efforts are leveraged to identify sustainable systemic enhancements that drive automation and ownership.
  + Supporting end-to-end testing of controls by planning and executing required test process steps.
  + Assessing the operational and design effectiveness of automated, hybrid, and manual controls.
  + Creating and maintaining adequate testing support documentation (BRDs, rationale, finding/issues reports).
* **Quality & Remediation**: Identifying internal control weaknesses and recommending remediation to strengthen the control environment.
* **Risk Event Management**: Serving as a Business Lead to identify, contain, and remediate issues in accordance with the Enterprise Risk Event standard, ensuring customers are made whole within a timely manner.
  + This includes coordinating fixes with key parties, maintaining open communication with the Event Management team, and actively participating in risk mitigation and recovery efforts.
  + Driving risk-related projects based on defined priorities to ensure scope, timelines, and deliverables are met while proactively identifying risks and mitigating or escalating as needed.

  

**Role-Based Competencies:**

* **Intellectually Curious**. You’re comfortable navigating between the big ideas and executional realities to create an achievable strategic semantics vision. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.
* **Communicator & Influencer**. You’re comfortable influencing a group of executives as well as communicating your semantics vision clearly to your associates and partners. You can be open to different communication styles and listen carefully to diverse sets of ideas.
* **Do-er.** You’re biased toward action, and are willing to make commitments and trade-offs with other leaders to remove impediments for your team; you are a leader obsessed with delivering value in an iterative way focusing in minimum viable product

* Works collaboratively with business leaders, project leaders, and impacted external stakeholders, coordinating efforts across those groups to analyze and assess readiness for change.

* Advanced ability to ensure that effective project controls are in place to monitor project or program performance
* Ability to work with business partners and program management team on development of LTC practices, policies, guidelines, and operational processes.
* Effective communication to all levels or the organization, including effectively presenting information and responding to questions or complex inquiries from groups of employees, managers and internal customers, influencing leadership and facilitation skills and working at functional and strategic levels simultaneously
* Monitor and direct day-to-day operations of the assigned tasks to ensure that policies and procedures are being followed, that contract and client goals and objectives are met, and that services and projects are being accomplished effectively and efficiently.

Areeva Solutions, LLC is seeking an experienced **Program Manager / IV&V Program Lead** who is accountable for the successful management and coordinated execution of Areeva’s HHS Systems IV&V contract. The role serves as the primary contractor interface with the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), leads contract governance and reporting, directs a cross-functional technical, functional, financial, and program support team, and ensures work remains aligned to the Statement of Work, schedule, quality standards, and approved customer priorities. The position also leads the evolution of IV&V toward a scalable, risk-based, evidence-driven oversight model across DIS systems and modernization initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide overall leadership, governance, and operational oversight for the IV&V contract; serve as the primary contractor point of contact to the COR and customer stakeholders.
* Plain, assign, coordinate, and monitor work across technical IV&V, functional verification, financial management, risk management, reporting, records, and program administration.
* Maintain the Project Management Plan and Task Management Plan, including schedules, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, staffing assumptions, and operational priorities.
* Lead recurring governance activities, including team stand-ups, Technical Management Reviews, PM/COR touchpoints, modernization coordination, and cross-organizational working sessions.
* Own or provide final management review for contract deliverables, including Weekly Activity Reports, Quarterly Status Reports, TMP updates, risk reports, executive briefings, meeting minutes, and supporting documentation; coordinate Financial Status Report review.
* Monitor contract performance, staffing, resource utilization, schedules, risks, issues, action items, and scope alignment; escalate concerns and recommend corrective or mitigating actions.

* Direct IV&V modernization and continuous improvement through independent oversight, evidence validation, risk-based prioritization, SDLC and release-readiness reviews, performance monitoring, functionality mapping, dashboards, and executive reporting.
* Oversee project records, SharePoint repositories, permissions, document control, quality review, Section 508 considerations, and compliance with contract, security, privacy, and records requirements.

new_jobs.title: Data Center Project Manager (Critical Infrastructure), Critical Projects Implementation
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operation data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced and proactive Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system. The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.
  
  
If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think big; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon data centers then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!  
  
This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure

new_jobs.title: Strategy & Business Operations Manager, Wolt Drive
new_jobs.description:
**About Wolt**
--------------

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.  
  
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

**About the role**
------------------

Wolt is on a growth journey as part of the DoorDash family, together with Deliveroo. **Drive** is our delivery-as-a-service business: we let merchants offer fast, reliable delivery in their own channels (their webshop, app or ordering system), powered by the Wolt and Deliveroo courier networks. We're now bringing Drive across Wolt and Deliveroo countries together into **one EMEA business**, with one team and a clear ambition: grow fast and build a business that stands on its own feet.

A growing share of that scaling comes from outside restaurants: grocers, retailers, pharmacies and other eComm players who want on-demand and same-day delivery for their own customers. Their needs can be very different from restaurants: bigger baskets, scheduled and batched deliveries, larger and heavier items, longer distances and more complex integrations. This brings us to you, our next **Manager, Strategy & Operations** for Grocery & Retail Drive.

You'll own this segment across EMEA, from strategy and planning to pricing, product requirements and performance. You'll work hand in hand with our regional commercial teams, who own the partner relationships, and with Product, Logistics, Finance and our Marketplace grocery & retail teams. You'll join the Drive EMEA Strategy & Operations team and report to the Director of Strategy & Operations, Drive EMEA.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Own the **Grocery & Retail strategy and annual plan** for Drive EMEA: where we play, which partners we go after, and the growth and profitability we commit to.
* Set the **commercial framework** for the segment, including pricing guidelines, deal economics and investment cases for our largest partnerships, together with the regional commercial leads.
* Act as the **voice of grocery and retail partners** towards Product and Logistics, turning commercial needs such as scheduled delivery or large and heavy items into sized, prioritized requirements.
* Run **performance management** for the segment: track growth, unit economics and service levels for our biggest partners, spot what's off and drive the fix with the teams involved.
* Shape how Drive works with our **Marketplace grocery & retail teams**, so partners get one joined-up offer from us.
* Turn wins into **playbooks** that country teams can reuse, from the first pitch to launch and scale-up.

**Our humble expectations**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, business development, commercial roles or management consulting, with a track record of owning outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Strong commercial and analytical skills: you can build a deal P&L or a segment plan from scratch, and defend it in front of a partner's leadership or our own.
* Proven ability to get things done across a matrix organization without direct authority, working with regional teams, Product, Logistics and Finance.
* You use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in your daily work, for example in analysis, planning and ways of working, and look for new ways to apply them to elevateyou - whilst maintaining strong judgement that comes from personal understanding complex systems
* Structured thinking and clear, concise communication in English, both written and spoken.
* Willingness to travel occasionally across our EMEA markets.

**Seen as a strong advantage:**

* Background in retail, grocery, e-commerce, logistics or on-demand delivery, either in-house or advising companies in these sectors.
* Experience with B2B platform or delivery-as-a-service businesses.

**Why you'll love it**
----------------------

* **Global and growing fast:** Be part of a fast-moving business at the moment it's being built, across two of Europe's best-known delivery brands
* **A segment to own:** Work with some of the biggest grocery and retail brands in Europe, and see what you write end up on the product roadmap
* **Ride of a lifetime:** Accelerate your career with direct access to DoorDash's global Drive experience and room to grow as the segment scales
* **Instant impact:** Take ownership and make a difference
* **Big hearts and small egos:** Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

**Next steps**
--------------

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply, make sure to add your CV in English and get the conversation going! We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

*Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at* *Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash* *.*

At Argos, we’re a digital-led UK retailer that keeps pushing boundaries to meet every generation with what they want, how and when they want it. The Crime and Security Manager is accountable for shaping and delivering the Argos crime, physical security and corporate security approach. Build influential relationships with police, emergency services, the National Business Crime Centre, industry bodies, other retailers and specialist partners, representing Argos and using external insight to strengthen our approach.

Sound judgement, integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information and making decisions that affect colleague and custom

new_jobs.description:
About the Role

  

Join the Export Local Markets & Travel Retail EMEA team as a Merchandising Project Manager on a permanent contract. You will be responsible for shaping and leading the end-to-end merchandising strategy for campaigns across more than 30 Local Markets and Travel Retail EMEA.

  
  

Reporting to the Category, Client Experience & Merchandising Manager, you will work closely with Category, Marketing, Sales, and Forecasting teams to ensure consistent, impactful, and market-relevant campaign deployments. The position is based in Paris. The application period will remain open for 2 weeks until 17 november 2026.

  
  

What impact you can create at Chanel

  

* Oversee the end-to-end merchandising strategy for campaigns, from budget development and forecasting including the delivery of non-catalogued campaign assets and define implementation guidelines to ensure consistent, high-quality execution across all points of sale.
  

  

* Co-develop the permanent assortment strategy with the Product Manager for local markets and EMEA Travel Retail, optimising the offer by point of sale according to its potential, format, available space, channel-specific requirements and business priorities.
  

  

* Define scalable, channel-specific merchandising solutions that address the diverse needs of local markets as well as the specific constraints of the Travel Retail channel.
  

  

* Support markets and partners throughout campaign deployment, ensuring clear communication, brand excellence and consistent implementation across all points of sale.
  

  

* Design and deliver campaign-focused training sessions and workshops, organise and facilitate seminars, and provide operational support to equip market and field teams with the merchandising skills, tools and best practices required to ensure consistent execution.
  

  

You are energised by

  

* The opportunity to shape how campaigns come to life across two complementary and highly diverse distribution environments, by developing strategies tailored to the specificities of Local Markets and Travel Retail EMEA.
  

  

* Becoming a key contributor in designing and deploying campaigns that combine the high standards of the Brand with the agility required to address the needs of each market and channel.
  

  

* Directly strengthening Brand visibility and desirability across the entire point-of-sale network.
  

  

* Playing a central coordination role between cross-functional teams and markets to continuously elevate executional excellence across the network.
  

  

What you will bring

  

* A Master’s degree or Business School background, with 3 to 5 years of experience in merchandising, operational marketing, campaign management, or a related field.
  

  

* Strong strategic thinking and project management skills, with the ability to turn campaign ambition into concrete retail execution.
  

  

* The ability to navigate complex, multicultural, and multi-channel environments, adapting solutions without compromising Brand standards.
  

  

* Fluent in French and English, you are comfortable communicating, engaging stakeholders, and building strong relationships in an international environment.
  

  

* Previous experience with the IWD merchandising software would be appreciated.
  

  

What Chanel can offer you

  

* The opportunity to operate within a uniquely rich and diverse distribution network: more than 30 Local Markets with varying levels of maturity, consumer profiles, and retail environments, alongside the distinctive Travel Retail ecosystem across airports in Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.
  

  

* The chance to shape a high-impact strategy, directly influencing Brand visibility, point-of-sale executional excellence, and commercial performance across both channels.
  

  

* The opportunity to strengthen your business and strategic perspective through the management of merchandising budgets and investment trade-offs across markets with diverse potential, challenges, and constraints.
  

  

* A rewarding management experience, supporting the development and autonomy of an apprentice.
  

  

* Guide markets and partners throughout campaign execution, ensuring clarity, Brand excellence, and consistent implementation across points of sale.
  

  

*At CHANEL, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.*

CDI – Merchandising Project Manager - Export Marchés Locaux & Travel Retail EMEA – CHANEL Europe – Janvier 2027 - H/F/X

  
  

À propos du poste

  

Vous rejoignez en CDI l’équipe Export Marchés Locaux & Travel Retail EMEA comme Chef(fe) de Projet Merchandising, en charge de la stratégie merchandising des campagnes de bout en bout sur plus de 30 marchés locaux et le Travel Retail.

  
  

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Category, Expérience Client & Merchandising, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Category, Marketing, Sales et Forecasting afin de garantir des déploiements cohérents, impactants et adaptés aux spécificités de chaque marché et canal. Le poste est basé à Paris. La période de candidature restera ouverte pendant deux semaines, jusqu’au 17 novembre 2026.

  
  
  

L’impact que vous pouvez créer chez CHANEL

  

* Superviser la stratégie merchandising de bout en bout pour les campagnes, depuis l’élaboration des budgets et des prévisions jusqu’à la livraison des supports de campagne hors catalogue, et définir les directives de mise en œuvre afin de garantir une exécution cohérente et de haute qualité sur l’ensemble des points de vente.
  

  

* Co-construire avec le Product Manager la stratégie d’assortiment permanent pour les marchés locau

**Réf. de l'offre :** AXAFR\_37499 **Localisation :** PUTEAUX - 92 **Contrat :** CDI Dispositifs handicap **Société :** AXA France Télétravail (selon profil poste) **Expérience :** Expérimentés **Salaire :** Selon profil et expérience

**VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS**
------------------------------

AXA is expanding its Employee Benefits activities internationally, supported by AXA EB Partners, a specialized Insurtech bringing together Employee Benefits expertise, digital delivery, data capabilities and integration excellence.

Founded in 2015, EB Partners brings together more than 75 internal and external team members across France, Japan and Vietnam. Its solutions currently support clients in 18 countries across Employee Benefits and Health.

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to join the EB Partners Service Excellence team and lead international initiatives around our Service Platform, a modular digital ecosystem designed for employees, employers, distributors and administrators.

You will work at the intersection of business, customer experience and technology, coordinating international stakeholders and helping local markets deliver engaging, scalable and locally relevant digital experiences. Projects span markets including France, Spain, Germany, Japan, Hong Kong and the Philippines, with opportunities to support further international expansion.

  

As Senior Project Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of Service Platform implementations and enhancements, from initial discovery and co-design through configuration, integration, UAT, deployment, adoption and post-go-live stabilization.You will:

  

* Lead international implementations of Employee, Employer, Distributor and Admin portals, coordinating local AXA teams and EB Partners specialists.
* Translate business and user needs into clear customer journeys, requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria and delivery roadmaps.
* Manage project scope, planning, milestones, dependencies, risks, governance and stakeholder communication.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams covering UX/UI, low-code/no-code configuration, development and systems integration.
* Promote a modular, reusable approach, leveraging existing global capabilities while adapting solutions to local business, regulatory and operational requirements.
* Coordinate integration requirements including authentication and SSO, APIs, data exchanges, document services, notifications, e-signature, payment and third-party services where applicable.
* Drive UAT, release readiness, training, deployment, adoption and post-launch support.
* Help shape healthcare and wellbeing service ecosystems by coordinating insurers, healthcare or wellbeing providers and other partners.
* Identify and assess opportunities for AI-enabled services, including AI chatbots and AI agents, and translate relevant use cases into pragmatic roadmaps considering business value, user experience, data readiness, integration, security, privacy and responsible AI.
* Facilitate workshops, steering committees and working groups, ensuring clear decisions, ownership and follow-up.
* Support local teams in building sustainable ownership of the platform and its configurable capabilities.

**VOTRE PROFIL**
----------------

You have at least 5 years of professional experience, with meaningful responsibility for digital portal, self-service, low-code/no-code or technology-enabled insurance projects. More than formal programme-management credentials, we value your ability to independently drive stakeholders, adoption and delivery outcomes.

  

You bring:

  

* Proven experience delivering customer, partner, employee or comparable B2B/B2C digital portals, from discovery through production rollout and adoption.
* Strong project management fundamentals across planning, governance, scope, risks, dependencies, UAT, release management and stakeholder decision-making.
* A good understanding of digital delivery topics such as UX/UI, CMS or low-code/no-code platforms, authentication/SSO, APIs and data interfaces.
* The ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements and delivery decisions for multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience working in agile or hybrid environments and proficiency with Jira and Confluence.
* Experience working in an international, matrixed environment with distributed teams.
* Fluent written and spoken English. Business-level French is preferred for French projects.
* Knowledge of Employee Benefits or insurance across Health, Protection or Pension is a strong advantage, as is familiarity with healthcare and wellbeing ecosystems.
* Previous IT development experience is a plus

**What will help you succeed**

  

You are comfortable taking ownership and moving projects forward without waiting for detailed direction. You know how to bring together stakeholders with different priorities, cultures and ways of working, and turn complexity into clear decisions and actions.

You combine a pragmatic, analytical mindset with strong communication skills. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, negotiating priorities and escalating risks early with practical options.

You are also curious about how emerging technologies, particularly generative AI, AI chatbots and AI agents, can improve digital services while meeting security, privacy, operational and responsible-AI requirements.

  

**The environment you will join**

  

EB Partners’ Service Platform combines reusable portal components with a low-code/no-code Builder platform to accelerate time to market while enabling local teams to adapt content and configurations.

The wider platform supports Employee Benefits journeys including enrolment, benefits and services, documents, claims, reporting and user administration, alongside capabilities such as digital claims management, enrolment automation and premium billing.

Meta is hiring a Reality Labs Product Data Operations Program Manager to run multilingual data collection (DC) for our language expansion work. Reality Labs builds the next generation of computing across Meta's mixed reality, virtual reality, and wearables products. As we bring AI experiences to more languages and regions, the quality, coverage, and speed of our multilingual data shape how well our models understand and respond to people around the world.In this role, you'll take model and product requirements from intake through delivery. For each request, you'll pick the collection model that fits best: in-house collection, scaled vendor collection, or a mix of both. You'll also build DC practices that can scale and repeat across languages and locales. You'll work across functions with research, engineering, product, quality, legal/privacy, and vendor partners. new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

**ReadyOn.AI** is an AI-native Labor Operating System that is redefining how the world’s largest enterprises manage frontline labor. Born out of a Stanford AI Lab, the company applies advanced AI and market-design principles to one of the hardest optimization problems on earth: matching the world’s 2.7 billion frontline workers to the right shifts, in real time.

Frontline workers now expect the same flexibility and autonomy that gig platforms provide, while large employers face relentless pressure to meet aggressive labor-cost targets. ReadyOn bridges that divide with a system of action that predicts workforce demand, dynamically matches it to an employer’s supply of employees, and automates the thousands of staffing decisions made daily across complex, multi-site operations.

The platform is already proven at global scale, powering labor operations for several of the world’s largest enterprises. Landmark customers include a F250 food-service enterprise (300K employees across 16 countries; $7B+ annual labor spend, a F500 hotel group (250K+ employees; $5B+ annual labor spend), a F250 entertainment operator (75K employees; $4B+ labor spend). Across these deployments, ReadyOn has proven that scheduling was never the real problem—it was a symptom. The true challenge is how to match people and work dynamically at scale. ReadyOn solves this problem with an AI system of action that transforms labor from a fixed cost into a strategic advantage, reshaping how enterprises think about workforce design altogether.

Headquartered in San Francisco with 80 employees, ReadyOn grew 8x year-over-year revenue growth in 2025, driven by multiple seven-figure Fortune 250 enterprise deployments and a rapidly expanding pipeline.

**Transform How Frontline Work Runs**

Enterprises struggle to manage hundreds of millions of dollars in frontline labor spend due to decades-old software and manual processes, creating massive, avoidable costs. Frontline labor often represents 40% of the P&L, yet the systems managing this $3 trillion market were built for static schedules and limited flexibility.

ReadyOn was founded to reject that paradigm. Staffing is not a scheduling problem; it is a real-time supply–demand orchestration problem. ReadyOn is an AI-native labor operating system, built from the ground up for AI agents to perform real-time labor optimization - much like ridesharing platforms that match drivers and riders in real time, but applied to frontline labor instead of fixed, one-size-fits-all schedules.

**Who’s Building It**

AI is not a bolt-on feature in our platform. Every decision, from demand forecasting to shift assignment, flows through an adaptive, autonomous decision layer that learns from operational data and continuously optimizes for cost, compliance, and worker satisfaction. Behind that system is a founding team of experts in labor markets, enterprise software, and AI-enabled platforms:

**Reza** **– Engineering leader who scaled enterprise systems at Google, Yahoo, and AT&T**

**Dominic** **– Operator who optimized labor-intensive operations in 21 countries**

**Mohammad** **– Stanford professor and leading expert in algorithmic market design**

ReadyOn has already proven product–market fit with multiple multi-million-dollar customers, consistent expansion within existing accounts, and measurable ROI that moves stock prices.

**Deployment Strategist Role**

Joining the Enterprise Partnerships team, the Deployment Strategist works across multiple customer deployments and alongside our Engagement Managers to turn complex labor environments into working ReadyOn deployments. You will contribute directly to live Fortune 500 implementations: building configurations, running data analyses, supporting training delivery, and joining customer engagements.

You will also build the structured product intelligence that helps Engineering and Product understand what is happening in the field. The best people in this role become the team’s institutional memory, and the role grows from deployment execution into product synthesis, analytical infrastructure, and solutions work. Strong performers move into Engagement Management, Solutions Engineering, or Product roles.

**Ideal Candidates:**

* **Learn by Doing:** You get up to speed quickly in unfamiliar tools, data, and operating environments, and you are comfortable contributing to live Fortune 500 deployments from day one.
* **Turn Data into Decisions:** You break down ambiguous operational questions, work directly with messy data, and move quickly from analysis to a clear recommendation.

* **Build for Reuse:** You look for the template, script, or playbook that makes the next deployment faster than the last, and you build it.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager III, Network Infrastructure Planning, Google Cloud
new_jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with supply or demand planning (e.g., demand forecasting, inventory management, resource allocation, etc.).
* Experience working with data analytics tools and reporting platforms.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience with supply/demand planning, material planning, data center infrastructure, or capital investment decision making.
* Experience in managing technical programs with hardware teams.
* Ability to take accountability and ownership for end-to-end project lifecycle.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As part of the Network Planning team, you will be responsible for enabling various data center networking deployments by working with cross functional teams to develop end to end strategies that connect our demand, supply, inventory, data center labor and deployment planning. Your role will directly enable improving effectiveness of network planning team and overall network domain.  
  
This role requires an individual to leverage strategic and end to end thinking. Successful individuals in this role have strong planning backgrounds with an engineering mindset, while being expert communicators and leaders. They are comfortable with ambiguity and complexity, yet strive to increase maturity in processes. They also have the ability to handle multiple programs at the same time while being highly customer focused.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Identify changes introduced by large scale business initiatives, drive business requirements and lead development/implementation with engineering teams to successfully land the programs.
* Partner with cross functional teams in deployments, supply chain planning, operations and engineering to identify, develop and lead large scale programs that improve our deployment velocity, inventory efficiency and supply resiliency.
* Develop and lead new forums, reports with key stakeholders and leaders to identify and flag risks, delivery challenges that need escalation, and highlight achievement of key milestones throughout the planning and execution cycles.
* Define, track and report on key performance metrics and raise issues proactively to ensure on-time follow-through.
* Define continuous improvement areas based upon metrics and work with engineering/systems team to establish program roadmaps to deliver the improvements.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

new_jobs.description:
About GoodLeap:

GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018.

GoodLeap is also proud to support our award-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.

#### **Position Summary:**

The Capital Markets Strategy & Operations Analyst supports the funding and sale of GoodLeap’s consumer finance loans by operationalizing revolving credit facilities, whole loan purchase agreements, and asset-backed securitizations. The Analyst manages day-to-day loan funding and sales activity, supports and maintains GoodLeap’s investor relationships, and works directly with lenders, capital partners, and their third-party vendors. Reporting to the Manager of Capital Markets Strategy & Operations, the Analyst collaborates closely with Capital Markets, Legal, Servicing, Underwriting, Product, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, and Business Development.

### **Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Initiates whole loan sales by determining loan pool eligibility against investor criteria, then preparing and delivering loan schedules, loan agreements, and underwriting documentation to investors.
* Serves as a point of contact for investors and their vendors during loan reviews, partnering with Product, Engineering, Servicing, and Underwriting to answer questions, evaluate exceptions, and resolve them.
* Manages day-to-day activity on GoodLeap’s revolving warehouse credit facilities, including borrowing base calculations, funding requests, and covenant compliance monitoring.
* Develops and maintains Excel-based models, including the Sales Engine and Funding Engine, and drives automation by identifying process improvements, defining requirements, and helping build and maintain capital markets software solutions.
* Analyzes alternatives, makes recommendations to management, and implements consumer finance funding and sales strategies.
* Leads new investor onboarding and prepares and analyzes ongoing investor and management reporting, flagging trends and issues for leadership.

### **Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:**

The Analyst brings at least two years of experience in financial modeling and analysis, and at least two years in capital markets, treasury, or finance. They have advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Databricks, and AI tools (e.g., Claude), with the technical ability to manipulate and analyze large datasets and apply statistical methods to them. They communicate findings clearly, in writing and verbally, to management, investors, and other external parties. They have a solid grasp of capital markets, finance, accounting, and business operations concepts, and ideally bring experience in financial services, consumer finance, fintech, or renewable energy finance. They work well across Capital Markets, Legal, Servicing, Underwriting, Product, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, and Business Development, and represent GoodLeap professionally while building lasting relationships with funding and capital partners. Above all, they are a curious, tenacious problem solver and a strong team player.

Compensation: $95,000-$105,000 plus bonus

The Company shall provide reasonable accommodations of known disabilities to enable a qualified applicant or employee to apply for employment, perform the essential functions of the job, or enjoy the benefits and privileges of employment as required by the law.
